This%0A * layer creates the overlay first, then the app code runs against it.%0A *%0A * Why a shadow root: a bookmarklet runs inside the host page and the page's own%0A * CSS would shred the app's layout. A shadow root isolates both directions, and%0A * a **constructed stylesheet** (`new CSSStyleSheet()` + adoptedStyleSheets)%0A * sidesteps `style-src`, which blocks an injected `<style>` on a strict-CSP page.%0A *%0A * Nothing here becomes a global on the host page: the vendored libraries are%0A * evaluated against a shadow object (`Object.create(window)`), so a page already%0A * shipping its own SheetJS or PapaParse keeps its own copies.%0A * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */%0A%0Avar TS_BMK = __TS_BMK__; Used for both the bar and the app's own stylesheet. */%0Afunction tsAdoptCss(text) {%0A  try {%0A    if (typeof CSSStyleSheet === 'function' && 'adoptedStyleSheets' in ShadowRoot.prototype) {%0A      var sheet = new CSSStyleSheet();%0A      sheet.replaceSync(text);%0A      TS_SHADOW.adoptedStyleSheets = TS_SHADOW.adoptedStyleSheets.concat(sheet);%0A      return 'constructed';%0A    }%0A  } catch (e) { console.warn('[Turnstone] constructed stylesheet unavailable', e); IndexedDB is shadowed with an in-memory stand-in so%0A * the app's snapshot code keeps working for the tab's lifetime — and the user's%0A * queue is never written into the host site's database. localStorage stays real%0A * (every access in the app is already guarded) because that is what remembers%0A * theme, open mode and column presets: small, namespaced keys. */%0Avar indexedDB = (function memIndexedDb() {%0A  var stores = {};%0A  function request() { return { result: undefined, onsuccess: null, onerror: null }; }%0A  function soon(fn) { setTimeout(fn, 0); }%0A  function makeStore(name) {%0A    if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(stores, name)) stores[name] = new Map();%0A    var map = stores[name];%0A    return {%0A      put: function (value) {%0A        var req = request();%0A        soon(function () { map.set(value.key, value); req.result = value.key; if (req.onsuccess) req.onsuccess(); });%0A        return req;%0A      },%0A      get: function (key) {%0A        var req = request();%0A        soon(function () { req.result = map.get(key); if (req.onsuccess) req.onsuccess(); });%0A        return req;%0A      },%0A      getAll: function () {%0A        var req = request();%0A        soon(function () { req.result = Array.from(map.values()); if (req.onsuccess) req.onsuccess(); });%0A        return req;%0A      },%0A      delete: function (key) {%0A        var req = request();%0A        soon(function () { map.delete(key); if (req.onsuccess) req.onsuccess(); });%0A        return req;%0A      },%0A      clear: function () {%0A        var req = request();%0A        soon(function () { map.clear(); if (req.onsuccess) req.onsuccess(); });%0A        return req;%0A      },%0A    };%0A  }%0A  return {%0A    open: function (name) {%0A      var req = request();%0A      soon(function () {%0A        req.result = {%0A          name: name,%0A          objectStoreNames: { contains: function (n) { return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(stores, n); } },%0A          createObjectStore: function (n) { makeStore(n); return {}; },%0A          transaction: function (n) {%0A            var os = makeStore(n);%0A            var tx = { objectStore: function () { return os; }, oncomplete: null, onerror: null, error: null };%0A            soon(function () { if (tx.oncomplete) tx.oncomplete(); });   // writes above are queued first%0A            return tx;%0A          },%0A        };%0A        if (req.onupgradeneeded) req.onupgradeneeded();%0A        if (req.onsuccess) req.onsuccess();%0A      });%0A      return req;%0A    },%0A  };%0A})();%0A%0A/* PapaParse stand-in — the app's API surface, in ~2 KB, no dependency. */%0A/* PapaParse stand-in — the exact slice of the API app.html consumes.%0A *%0A *   Papa.parse(text, { skipEmptyLines: 'greedy', delimiter }) -> { data, errors, meta: { delimiter } }%0A *   Papa.unparse(matrix, { delimiter })                        -> string%0A *%0A * Real RFC-4180 behaviour (quoted fields, doubled quotes, embedded commas and%0A * newlines, CRLF, BOM) plus delimiter sniffing, in ~2 KB and with no dependency.%0A * That is what lets the zero-library bookmarklet keep full CSV/TSV support —%0A * the hosted app loads the real PapaParse through vendor/ instead.%0A */%0Avar Papa = (function () {%0A  var CANDIDATES = [',', '\t', ';', '|'];%0A%0A  /** Delimiter counts on a line, ignoring anything inside quotes. */%0A  function countOutsideQuotes(line, delim) {%0A    var n = 0, quoted = false;%0A    for (var i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {%0A      var ch = line[i];%0A      if (quoted) {%0A        if (ch === '"') {%0A          if (line[i + 1] === '"') i++;%0A          else quoted = false;%0A        }%0A      } else if (ch === '"') quoted = true;%0A      else if (ch === delim) n++;%0A    }%0A    return n;%0A  }%0A%0A  /** Pick the delimiter that splits the most lines into the same number of fields. */%0A  function sniff(text) {%0A    var lines = text.split(/\r?\n/).slice(0, 30).filter(function (l) { return l.trim() !== ''; });%0A    if (!lines.length) return ',';%0A    var best = ',', bestScore = 0;%0A    for (var c = 0; c < CANDIDATES.length; c++) {%0A      var d = CANDIDATES[c];%0A      var counts = lines.map(function (l) { return countOutsideQuotes(l, d); });%0A      var sorted = counts.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });%0A      var median = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)];%0A      if (median < 1) continue;                                     // delim never appears%0A      var agree = counts.filter(function (n) { return n === median; }).length / counts.length;%0A      var score = median * agree;%0A      if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = d; }%0A    }%0A    return best;%0A  }%0A%0A  /** RFC-4180 state machine. Unterminated quotes are an error, not a crash. */%0A  function splitRows(text, delim, errors) {%0A    var rows = [], row = [], field = '', quoted = false, i = 0;%0A    var sawField = false;%0A    while (i < text.length) {%0A      var ch = text[i];%0A      if (quoted) {%0A        if (ch === '"') {%0A          if (text[i + 1] === '"') { field += '"'; i += 2; continue; }%0A          quoted = false; i++; continue;%0A        }%0A        field += ch; i++; continue;%0A      }%0A      if (ch === '"' && field === '') { quoted = true; sawField = true; i++; continue; }%0A      if (ch === delim) { row.push(field); field = ''; sawField = true; i++; continue; }%0A      if (ch === '\r') { i++; continue; }                            // CRLF or lone CR%0A      if (ch === '\n') {%0A        if (field !== '' || sawField || row.length) { row.push(field); rows.push(row); }%0A        row = []; field = ''; sawField = false; i++; continue;%0A      }%0A      field += ch; sawField = true; i++;%0A    }%0A    if (quoted) errors.push({ type: 'Quotes', message: 'Unterminated quoted field', row: rows.length });%0A    if (field !== '' || sawField || row.length) { row.push(field); rows.push(row); }%0A    return rows;%0A  }%0A%0A  function parse(text, opts) {%0A    opts = opts || {};%0A    var errors = [];%0A    var delim = opts.delimiter || sniff(text);%0A    var data = splitRows(String(text == null ? '' : text), delim, errors);%0A    if (opts.skipEmptyLines) {%0A      data = data.filter(function (r) { return r.some(function (c) { return String(c).trim() !== ''; }); });%0A    }%0A    return { data: data, errors: errors, meta: { delimiter: delim } };%0A  }%0A%0A  function needsQuotes(s, delim) {%0A    return s.indexOf('"') >= 0 || s.indexOf('\n') >= 0 || s.indexOf('\r') >= 0%0A      || s.indexOf(delim) >= 0 || s.charAt(0) === ' ' || s.charAt(s.length - 1) === ' ';%0A  }%0A%0A  function unparse(rows, opts) {%0A    var delim = (opts && opts.delimiter) || ',';%0A    return rows.map(function (row) {%0A      return row.map(function (cell) {%0A        var s = cell == null ? '' : String(cell);%0A        return needsQuotes(s, delim) ? '"' + s.replace(/"/g, '""') + '"' : s;%0A      }).join(delim);%0A    }).join('\n');%0A  }%0A%0A  return {%0A    parse: parse,%0A    unparse: unparse,%0A    shim: true,                       // app/payload can log which implementation is live%0A  };%0A})();%0A%0A/* SheetJS stand-in — read-only XLSX via the browser's own ZIP + DecompressionStream. */%0A/* SheetJS stand-in — read-only XLSX support with zero dependencies.%0A *%0A * Implements exactly the API surface app.html consumes:%0A *   XLSX.read(buf, { type:'array' })                  -> Promise<{ SheetNames, Sheets, version }>%0A *   XLSX.read(buf, { type:'array', bookSheets: true }) -> Promise<{ SheetNames }>%0A *   XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, { header:1 })          -> string[][]%0A *%0A * `XLSX.write` is deliberately absent, so the app reports HAS_XLSX_WRITE=false,%0A * treats workbooks as one-way imports and hides XLSX export — the locked-scope%0A * rule that a build must never promise a write-back it cannot deliver.%0A *%0A * How it works without SheetJS: an .xlsx file is a ZIP of XML. The ZIP is walked%0A * through its central directory, each member inflated with the browser's own%0A * DecompressionStream('deflate-raw'), and the sheet/shared-string XML read with%0A * DOMParser. No eval, no blob-script injection, no network — which is what makes%0A * this variant survivable under a strict page CSP.%0A *%0A * Deliberately not supported (throws a readable reason instead): .xls (BIFF8),%0A * .xlsb, .ods, and cell number formats (dates arrive as their stored serial).%0A */%0Avar XLSX = (function () {%0A  var ENTRY_SIG = 0x04034b50, CD_SIG = 0x02014b50, EOCD_SIG = 0x06054b50;%0A  var REL_NS = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships';%0A%0A  function u16(dv, o) { return dv.getUint16(o, true); }%0A  function u32(dv, o) { return dv.getUint32(o, true); }%0A%0A  /** Locate the End Of Central Directory record by scanning back from the tail. */%0A  function findEocd(dv) {%0A    var min = Math.max(0, dv.byteLength - 65557 - 22);%0A    for (var i = dv.byteLength - 22; i >= min; i--) {%0A      if (u32(dv, i) === EOCD_SIG) return i;%0A    }%0A    return -1;%0A  }%0A%0A  /** name -> central-directory entry (offset/size/method). */%0A  function readCentralDirectory(buf) {%0A    var dv = new DataView(buf);%0A    var eocd = findEocd(dv);%0A    if (eocd < 0) throw new Error('not a ZIP container (no end-of-central-directory record) — not an .xlsx file?');%0A    var count = u16(dv, eocd + 10);%0A    var offset = u32(dv, eocd + 16);%0A    var entries = {};%0A    for (var n = 0; n < count; n++) {%0A      if (u32(dv, offset) !== CD_SIG) break;%0A      var method = u16(dv, offset + 10);%0A      var compSize = u32(dv, offset + 20);%0A      var nameLen = u16(dv, offset + 28);%0A      var extraLen = u16(dv, offset + 30);%0A      var commentLen = u16(dv, offset + 32);%0A      var localOffset = u32(dv, offset + 42);%0A      var name = new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(new Uint8Array(buf, offset + 46, nameLen));%0A      entries[name] = { method: method, compSize: compSize, localOffset: localOffset };%0A      offset += 46 + nameLen + extraLen + commentLen;%0A    }%0A    return entries;%0A  }%0A%0A  /** Inflate (stored or deflate) one member to text. */%0A  async function readEntryText(buf, entry) {%0A    var dv = new DataView(buf);%0A    if (u32(dv, entry.localOffset) !== ENTRY_SIG) throw new Error('corrupt ZIP member header');%0A    var nameLen = u16(dv, entry.localOffset + 26);%0A    var extraLen = u16(dv, entry.localOffset + 28);%0A    var start = entry.localOffset + 30 + nameLen + extraLen;%0A    var bytes = new Uint8Array(buf, start, entry.compSize);%0A    if (entry.method === 0) return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(bytes);%0A    if (entry.method !== 8) throw new Error('unsupported ZIP compression method ' + entry.method);%0A    if (typeof DecompressionStream !== 'function') {%0A      throw new Error('this browser cannot inflate XLSX parts (no DecompressionStream) — use the full build or export to CSV');%0A    }%0A    var stream = new Blob([bytes]).stream().pipeThrough(new DecompressionStream('deflate-raw'));%0A    return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());%0A  }%0A%0A  function parseXml(text, label) {%0A    var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(text, 'application/xml');%0A    var bad = doc.querySelector('parsererror');%0A    if (bad) throw new Error('could not read ' + label + ' XML');%0A    return doc;%0A  }%0A%0A  /** "BC12" -> 54 (zero-based column index). */%0A  function colIndex(ref) {%0A    var letters = String(ref || '').match(/^[A-Za-z]+/);%0A    if (!letters) return 0;%0A    var s = letters[0].toUpperCase(), n = 0;%0A    for (var i = 0; i < s.length; i++) n = n * 26 + (s.charCodeAt(i) - 64);%0A    return n - 1;%0A  }%0A%0A  /** Every <t> under a shared-string <si>, so rich text runs concatenate. */%0A  function sharedStringsOf(text) {%0A    if (text == null) return [];%0A    var doc = parseXml(text, 'sharedStrings');%0A    return Array.prototype.map.call(doc.getElementsByTagName('si'), function (si) {%0A      return Array.prototype.map.call(si.getElementsByTagName('t'), function (t) { return t.textContent; }).join('');%0A    });%0A  }%0A%0A  function relationshipTargets(text) {%0A    var doc = parseXml(text, 'workbook relationships');%0A    var map = {};%0A    Array.prototype.forEach.call(doc.getElementsByTagName('Relationship'), function (rel) {%0A      map[rel.getAttribute('Id')] = rel.getAttribute('Target');%0A    });%0A    return map;%0A  }%0A%0A  /** Sheet name -> worksheet part path, in workbook order. */%0A  function sheetParts(workbookXml, rels) {%0A    var doc = parseXml(workbookXml, 'workbook');%0A    var sheets = doc.getElementsByTagName('sheet');%0A    return Array.prototype.map.call(sheets, function (s) {%0A      var rid = s.getAttributeNS(REL_NS, 'id') || s.getAttribute('r:id');%0A      var target = rels[rid] || '';%0A      if (/^\//.test(target)) target = target.slice(1);            // absolute package path%0A      else if (target) target = 'xl/' + target.replace(/^\.\//, '');%0A      return { name: s.getAttribute('name') || 'Sheet1', path: target };%0A    });%0A  }%0A%0A  /** One worksheet -> dense 2D array of strings (or numbers-as-written). */%0A  function gridFromSheet(xml, strings) {%0A    var doc = parseXml(xml, 'worksheet');%0A    var rows = doc.getElementsByTagName('row');%0A    var grid = [], width = 0;%0A    Array.prototype.forEach.call(rows, function (row) {%0A      var rowIndex = parseInt(row.getAttribute('r'), 10);%0A      if (isNaN(rowIndex)) rowIndex = grid.length + 1;%0A      var out = [];%0A      Array.prototype.forEach.call(row.getElementsByTagName('c'), function (cell) {%0A        var at = colIndex(cell.getAttribute('r'));%0A        var type = cell.getAttribute('t') || 'n';%0A        var value = '';%0A        if (type === 'inlineStr') {%0A          var is = cell.getElementsByTagName('is')[0];%0A          value = is ? Array.prototype.map.call(is.getElementsByTagName('t'), function (t) { return t.textContent; }).join('') : '';%0A        } else {%0A          var v = cell.getElementsByTagName('v')[0];%0A          var raw = v ? v.textContent : '';%0A          if (type === 's') value = strings[parseInt(raw, 10)] || '';%0A          else if (type === 'b') value = raw === '1' ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE';%0A          else value = raw;%0A        }%0A        out[at] = value;%0A        if (at + 1 > width) width = at + 1;%0A      });%0A      while (grid.length < rowIndex - 1) grid.push([]);            // honour sparse rows%0A      grid[rowIndex - 1] = out;%0A    });%0A    for (var r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {%0A      var row = grid[r] || [];%0A      for (var c = 0; c < width; c++) if (row[c] === undefined) row[c] = '';%0A      row.length = width;%0A      grid[r] = row;%0A    }%0A    return grid;%0A  }%0A%0A  function utils() {%0A    return {%0A      /** The slice app.html uses: { header: 1, raw: false, defval: '' }. */%0A      sheet_to_json: function (ws, opts) {%0A        opts = opts || {};%0A        var defval = opts.defval === undefined ? '' : opts.defval;%0A        return (ws.rows || []).map(function (row) {%0A          return row.map(function (cell) { return cell === undefined || cell === null ? defval : cell; });%0A        });%0A      },%0A    };%0A  }%0A%0A  async function read(buf, opts) {%0A    opts = opts || {};%0A    var head = new Uint8Array(buf, 0, Math.min(8, buf.byteLength));%0A    if (head[0] === 0xD0 && head[1] === 0xCF && head[2] === 0x11 && head[3] === 0xE0) {%0A      throw new Error('legacy .xls (BIFF8) needs the full build — re-save it as .xlsx or CSV');%0A    }%0A    var entries = readCentralDirectory(buf);%0A    if (!entries['xl/workbook.xml']) {%0A      if (entries['content.xml']) throw new Error('.ods workbooks need the full build — re-save as .xlsx or CSV');%0A      if (entries['xl/workbook.bin']) throw new Error('.xlsb workbooks need the full build — re-save as .xlsx or CSV');%0A      throw new Error('no xl/workbook.xml inside the archive — not a readable .xlsx file');%0A    }%0A    var parts = sheetParts(await readEntryText(buf, entries['xl/workbook.xml']),%0A      entries['xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'] ? relationshipTargets(await readEntryText(buf, entries['xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'])) : {});%0A    var names = parts.map(function (p) { return p.name; });%0A    if (opts.bookSheets) return { SheetNames: names };%0A%0A    var strings = sharedStringsOf(entries['xl/sharedStrings.xml'] ? await readEntryText(buf, entries['xl/sharedStrings.xml']) : null);%0A    var Sheets = {};%0A    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {%0A      var p = parts[i];%0A      var entry = entries[p.path] || entries['xl/worksheets/sheet' + (i + 1) + '.xml'];%0A      if (!entry) continue;%0A      Sheets[p.name] = { rows: gridFromSheet(await readEntryText(buf, entry), strings) };%0A    }%0A    return { SheetNames: names, Sheets: Sheets, version: 'turnstone-mini', mini: true };%0A  }%0A%0A  return { read: read, utils: utils(), mini: true };%0A})();%0A%0A%0A(function(){%0A%0A'use strict';%0A/* =========================================================================%0A   Project Turnstone — zero-server URL-list processor.%0A   Vanilla JS. Workspace on the LEFT, task sidebar on the RIGHT (deviation).%0A   ========================================================================= */%0A%0Aconst LOG = '[Turnstone]';%0Aconst log  = (...a) => console.log(LOG, ...a);%0Aconst warn = (...a) => console.warn(LOG, ...a);%0Aconst err  = (...a) => console.error(LOG, ...a);%0A%0A/* ---------------------------- IndexedDB layer ---------------------------- */%0Aconst DB_NAME = 'turnstone', DB_VER = 1;%0Alet idbPromise = null;%0A%0Afunction idbOpen() {%0A  if (idbPromise) return idbPromise;%0A  idbPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {%0A    const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VER);%0A    req.onupgradeneeded = () => {%0A      const db = req.result;%0A      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('handles')) db.createObjectStore('handles', { keyPath: 'key' });%0A      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('session')) db.createObjectStore('session', { keyPath: 'key' });%0A      log('IndexedDB stores created');%0A    };%0A    req.onsuccess = () => { log('IndexedDB opened'); resolve(req.result); };%0A    req.onerror = () => { err('IndexedDB open failed', req.error); reject(req.error); };%0A  });%0A  return idbPromise;%0A}%0Aasync function idbPut(store, value) {%0A  const db = await idbOpen();%0A  return new Promise((res, rej) => {%0A    const tx = db.transaction(store, 'readwrite');%0A    tx.objectStore(store).put(value);%0A    tx.oncomplete = () => { log(`IDB put → ${store}/${value.key}`); res(); };%0A    tx.onerror = () => { err(`IDB put failed → ${store}/${value.key}`, tx.error); rej(tx.error); };%0A  });%0A}%0Aasync function idbGet(store, key) {%0A  const db = await idbOpen();%0A  return new Promise((res, rej) => {%0A    const req = db.transaction(store).objectStore(store).get(key);%0A    req.onsuccess = () => res(req.result);%0A    req.onerror = () => { err(`IDB get failed → ${store}/${key}`, req.error); rej(req.error); };%0A  });%0A}%0Aasync function idbGetAll(store) {%0A  const db = await idbOpen();%0A  return new Promise((res, rej) => {%0A    const req = db.transaction(store).objectStore(store).getAll();%0A    req.onsuccess = () => res(req.result || []);%0A    req.onerror = () => { err(`IDB getAll failed → ${store}`, req.error); rej(req.error); };%0A  });%0A}%0A%0A/* --------------------------------- State --------------------------------- */%0Aconst state = {%0A  name: null,          // file name or URL label%0A  ext: 'csv',          // format id: csv | tsv | xlsx | xls | ods | json | html | xml%0A  mode: null,          // 'fs' (File System Access) | 'fallback' | 'remote' | 'demo'%0A  fileHandle: null,    // FileSystemFileHandle (Chromium only)%0A  sheetName: 'Sheet1',%0A  data: [],            // 2D array, exactly as parsed%0A  hasHeader: false,%0A  urlCol: 0, nameCol: -1, statusCol: -1, notesCol: -1,%0A  status: [],          // virtual per-card status ('incomplete'|'complete'), cardIndex-based%0A  notes: [],           // virtual per-card notes%0A  isDirty: false,%0A  search: '', hideCompleted: true,   // completed cards hidden by default (toggle: Show completed)%0A  sortCol: null, sortAsc: true,      // card ordering; null = file order%0A  autoOpenOnSelect: false,           // open a link as soon as its card is expanded%0A  autoAdvance: false,                // open the next incomplete card's link when one is completed%0A  sourceUrl: null,      // remote URL the file was fetched from (?file=/ pasted), enables 🔗 Link%0A  colOrder: null,       // card-display order of data columns (indices); null = file order%0A  colHidden: {},        // column index → true when hidden from cards%0A  expanded: {},         // card index → true when all data columns are shown%0A};%0A%0Aconst $ = (sel) => ROOT.querySelector(sel);%0Aconst els = {%0A  fileInput: $('%23file-input'), dropzone: $('%23dropzone'), btnDemo: $('%23btn-demo'),%0A  dzFormats: $('%23dz-formats'), capNotice: $('%23cap-notice'),%0A  btnMenu: $('%23btn-menu'), menu: $('%23menu'), headName: $('%23head-name'), headSave: $('%23head-save'),%0A  miOpen: $('%23mi-open'), miRestore: $('%23mi-restore'), miClose: $('%23mi-close'), miLink: $('%23mi-link'),%0A  miColumns: $('%23mi-columns'), miExportCsv: $('%23mi-export-csv'), miExportXlsx: $('%23mi-export-xlsx'),%0A  miInstall: $('%23mi-install'), miTheme: $('%23mi-theme'), miThemeLabel: $('%23mi-theme-label'),%0A  miAutoOpen: $('%23mi-auto-open'), miAutoAdvance: $('%23mi-auto-advance'),%0A  settingsOverlay: $('%23settings-overlay'), settingsCols: $('%23settings-cols'), settingsPresets: $('%23settings-presets'),%0A  settingsX: $('%23settings-x'), presetName: $('%23preset-name'), btnPresetSave: $('%23btn-preset-save'), btnColsReset: $('%23btn-cols-reset'),%0A  urlInput: $('%23url-input'), btnLoadUrl: $('%23btn-load-url'),%0A  btnTestCsv: $('%23btn-test-csv'), btnTestXlsx: $('%23btn-test-xlsx'),%0A  welcome: $('%23welcome'), recents: $('%23recents'), recentsList: $('%23recents-list'),%0A  tabbar: $('%23tabbar'), panes: $('%23panes'),%0A  search: $('%23search'), showCompleted: $('%23show-completed'), filterInfo: $('%23filter-info'),%0A  sortCol: $('%23sort-col'), sortDir: $('%23sort-dir'),%0A  cards: $('%23cards'),%0A  countTotal: $('%23count-total'), countDone: $('%23count-done'), countLeft: $('%23count-left'),%0A  toast: $('%23toast'),%0A};%0A%0A/* ------------------------------- Utilities ------------------------------- */%0Afunction esc(s) {%0A  return String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&%2339;' }[c]));%0A}%0Afunction highlight(text, q) {%0A  const raw = String(text ?? '');%0A  if (!q) return esc(raw);%0A  const rx = new RegExp(q.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), 'gi');%0A  return raw.split(rx).map(esc).join('<mark>' + esc(q) + '</mark>'); // split keeps separators; escape every part%0A}%0Afunction escapeRegExp(s) { return s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'); }%0A%0Alet toastTimer = null;%0Afunction toast(msg, type = '') {%0A  log('Toast:', msg);%0A  els.toast.textContent = msg;%0A  els.toast.className = 'show ' + type;%0A  clearTimeout(toastTimer);%0A  toastTimer = setTimeout(() => { els.toast.className = ''; }, 3500);%0A}%0A%0Aasync function copyText(text, label = 'text') {%0A  try {%0A    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);%0A    log(`Copied ${label} to clipboard (${text.length} chars)`);%0A    return true;%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    warn('Clipboard API failed, falling back to execCommand', e);%0A    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');%0A    ta.value = text; ta.style.position = 'fixed'; ta.style.opacity = '0';%0A    document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select();%0A    const ok = document.execCommand('copy');%0A    ta.remove();%0A    log(`execCommand copy ${ok ? 'succeeded' : 'failed'} for ${label}`);%0A    return ok;%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------------ Parsing core ------------------------------ */%0A/* Every supported input — CSV, TSV, XLSX/XLS/ODS, JSON, HTML tables, XML —%0A   collapses into ONE shape: a 2D array of strings. Everything downstream%0A   (analyzeMatrix → loadMatrix → renderCards) is format-agnostic, so adding a%0A   format means one detector entry plus one parser that returns rows. */%0A%0Aconst HEADER_URL_RE = /^(url|link|href|website|web site|site|address|loc|permalink)\b/i;%0Aconst HEADER_NAME_RE = /^(name|title|task|label|page|description)\b/i;%0Aconst URL_VALUE_RE = /^https?:\/\//i;%0A%0A/* Completed/status + notes columns. We emit "Status"/"Notes" on export, but a%0A   file dropped back in (or built elsewhere) may label them Completed / Done /%0A   Finished / Checked / Comment — accepting that whole family is what lets a%0A   re-import resume the user's progress instead of resetting every card. */%0Aconst HEADER_STATUS_RE = /^(status|state|complet(e|ed|ion)|done|finished|checked|reviewed|processed|handled)\b/i;%0Aconst HEADER_NOTES_RE  = /^(notes?|comments?|remarks?|memo)\b/i;%0Aconst STATUS_HEADER_WORDS = new Set(['status', 'state', 'complete', 'completed', 'completion', 'done', 'finished', 'checked', 'reviewed', 'processed', 'handled']);%0Aconst NOTES_HEADER_WORDS  = new Set(['note', 'notes', 'comment', 'comments', 'remark', 'remarks', 'memo']);%0Aconst normalizeHeader = (h) => String(h ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g, '');%0A%0A/** Cell values that mean "this task is done". Ticks are accepted so rows pasted%0A    from a spreadsheet round-trip, and a completion *date* counts as done too. */%0Aconst COMPLETE_RE = /^(complete|completed|done|finished|yes|y|true|1|x|✓|✔|☑|✅)$/i;%0Aconst COMPLETE_DATE_RE = /^\d{4}-\d{1,2}-\d{1,2}([T ].*)?$/;%0A/* Same test after stripping decoration, so "✓ done", "done ✔" and "- complete"%0A   all count. Anchored matches keep "not done" and "incomplete" safely false. */%0Aconst DONE_DECOR_RE = /[\s✓✔☑✅·•\-–—:]/g;%0Aconst isCompleteValue = (raw) => {%0A  const v = String(raw ?? '').trim().replace(/\uFE0F/g, '');   // drop emoji variation selectors%0A  if (!v) return false;%0A  return COMPLETE_RE.test(v) || COMPLETE_RE.test(v.replace(DONE_DECOR_RE, '')) || COMPLETE_DATE_RE.test(v);%0A};%0A%0A/* `writable` = we can rebuild the file byte-for-byte in its own format, so edits%0A   save silently in place. Everything else is a one-way import: its edits live in%0A   browser storage until the user exports CSV/XLSX. XLS/XLSM/XLSB/ODS are read-only%0A   on purpose — writing XLSX bytes under a .xls/.xlsm name would drop macros and%0A   mislabel the file. */%0Aconst FORMAT_INFO = {%0A  csv:  { label: 'CSV',        writable: true  },%0A  tsv:  { label: 'TSV',        writable: true  },%0A  xlsx: { label: 'XLSX',       writable: true  },%0A  xls:  { label: 'XLS',        writable: false },%0A  xlsm: { label: 'XLSM',       writable: false },%0A  xlsb: { label: 'XLSB',       writable: false },%0A  ods:  { label: 'ODS',        writable: false },%0A  json: { label: 'JSON',       writable: false },%0A  html: { label: 'HTML table', writable: false },%0A  xml:  { label: 'XML',        writable: false },%0A  pdf:  { label: 'PDF',        writable: false },%0A};%0Aconst formatLabel = (f) => (FORMAT_INFO[f] || {}).label || String(f || '').toUpperCase();%0A/** Formats whose matrix can be written back into the source file in place. */%0Aconst isWritable = (f) => !!(FORMAT_INFO[f] && FORMAT_INFO[f].writable);%0A%0A/* Workbook support is a **capability**, not a build assumption. The bookmarklet's%0A   no-library variant and the standalone CSV-only build ship without SheetJS, and%0A   the app must degrade out loud: refuse `.xlsx` with a real reason, hide the XLSX%0A   export, and say so on the welcome panel — never fail on the first workbook. */%0Aconst HAS_XLSX = typeof XLSX === 'object' && XLSX !== null && typeof XLSX.read === 'function';%0A/* Reading a workbook and *rebuilding* one are separate capabilities: a build can%0A   ship a read-only workbook reader (the bookmarklet's zero-library variant does)%0A   and must then treat workbooks as one-way imports instead of promising a%0A   write-back it cannot deliver. */%0Aconst HAS_XLSX_WRITE = HAS_XLSX && typeof XLSX.write === 'function';%0A/* Some builds have no durable storage at all — the bookmarklet overlay runs on a%0A   throwaway origin and shadows IndexedDB. Those builds must say so instead of%0A   promising a snapshot that will not outlive the tab. */%0Aconst SESSION_ONLY = true;   // ports/bookmarklet/build.js flips this to true%0Aconst storageLabel = () => (SESSION_ONLY ? 'this tab only' : 'browser storage');%0A/** Formats we can rebuild in place, given this build's capabilities. */%0Aconst canWrite = (f) => isWritable(f) && (!isWorkbookFormat(f) || HAS_XLSX_WRITE);%0A/** Everything SheetJS opens as a workbook container. */%0Aconst isWorkbookFormat = (f) => f === 'xlsx' || f === 'xls' || f === 'xlsm' || f === 'xlsb' || f === 'ods';%0A%0A/* Extension → format. Explicit aliases only; content sniffing outranks them. */%0Aconst EXT_FORMAT = {%0A  csv: 'csv', txt: 'csv', tsv: 'tsv', tab: 'tsv',%0A  xlsx: 'xlsx', xlsm: 'xlsm', xlsb: 'xlsb', xls: 'xls', ods: 'ods',%0A  json: 'json', jsonl: 'json', ndjson: 'json',%0A  html: 'html', htm: 'html', xml: 'xml', rss: 'xml', atom: 'xml', opml: 'xml',%0A  pdf: 'pdf',%0A};%0Aconst CT_FORMAT = [%0A  [/spreadsheetml|ms-excel|excel/, 'xlsx'],%0A  [/opendocument\.spreadsheet/, 'ods'],%0A  [/json/, 'json'],%0A  [/html/, 'html'],%0A  [/xml/, 'xml'],%0A  [/tab-separated/, 'tsv'],%0A  [/csv|comma-separated/, 'csv'],%0A  [/pdf/, 'pdf'],%0A];%0A%0Aconst MAGIC = {%0A  pdf: [0x25, 0x50, 0x44, 0x46], // %25PDF%0A  ole: [0xd0, 0xcf, 0x11, 0xe0], // OLE2 container — legacy .xls%0A  zip: [0x50, 0x4b, 0x03, 0x04], // PK\x03\x04 — xlsx / xlsm / xlsb / ods%0A};%0Afunction hasMagic(buf, bytes) {%0A  return buf.byteLength >= bytes.length && bytes.every((b, i) => new DataView(buf).getUint8(i) === b);%0A}%0Afunction bufHead(buf, n = 2048) {%0A  return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(buf.slice(0, Math.min(n, buf.byteLength))).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');%0A}%0A%0A/** Content sniffing for text formats — the strongest signal we have. */%0Afunction sniffTextFormat(head) {%0A  const h = head.trimStart().toLowerCase();%0A  if (!h) return null;%0A  if (h[0] === '[' || h[0] === '{') return 'json';%0A  if (h.startsWith('<!doctype html') || h.startsWith('<html')) return 'html';%0A  if (h.startsWith('<?xml')) return 'xml';%0A  if (h.startsWith('<!--')) return /<!doctype html|<html|<table/.test(h) ? 'html' : 'xml';%0A  if (h[0] === '<') return /<table\b|<tr\b|<td\b/.test(h) ? 'html' : 'xml';%0A  return null; // delimiter choice is PapaParse's job, not ours%0A}%0A%0A/** Split an extension + Content-Type into soft hints used only when content is inconclusive. */%0Afunction formatHints(name, contentType) {%0A  const m = String(name || '').match(/\.([a-z0-9]{1,5})(?:$|[?%23])/i);%0A  const ext = m ? m[1].toLowerCase() : null;%0A  const ct = String(contentType || '').toLowerCase();%0A  const hit = CT_FORMAT.find(([re]) => re.test(ct));%0A  return { ext, extFormat: (ext && EXT_FORMAT[ext]) || null, ctFormat: hit ? hit[1] : null, contentType: ct };%0A}%0A%0A/** Decide the format of a buffer. Precedence: magic bytes → content → hints. */%0Afunction detectFormat(buf, name, contentType) {%0A  const hint = formatHints(name, contentType);%0A  let format, why;%0A  if (hasMagic(buf, MAGIC.pdf)) { format = 'pdf'; why = 'magic %25PDF'; }%0A  else if (hasMagic(buf, MAGIC.ole)) { format = 'xls'; why = 'magic OLE2 (legacy Excel)'; }%0A  else if (hasMagic(buf, MAGIC.zip)) {%0A    // xlsx / xlsm / xlsb / ods all share the ZIP magic — the extension says which.%0A    format = isWorkbookFormat(hint.extFormat) ? hint.extFormat : 'xlsx';%0A    why = `magic PK\\x03\\x04 (ZIP container → ${format})`;%0A  } else {%0A    const sniffed = sniffTextFormat(bufHead(buf));%0A    if (sniffed) { format = sniffed; why = 'content sniff'; }%0A    else if (hint.extFormat) { format = hint.extFormat; why = `extension .${hint.ext}`; }%0A    else if (hint.ctFormat) { format = hint.ctFormat; why = `content-type "${hint.contentType}"`; }%0A    else { format = 'csv'; why = 'assumed delimited text'; }%0A  }%0A  log(`Format detection: ${why} → ${format} (ext=${hint.ext || 'none'}, content-type="${hint.contentType || 'none'}")`);%0A  return { format, ...hint };%0A}%0A%0A/* ---- Parser: delimited text (CSV, TSV, semicolon/pipe) ---- */%0Afunction parseDelimitedText(text, format) {%0A  const t = String(text).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim();%0A  const res = Papa.parse(t, { skipEmptyLines: 'greedy', delimiter: format === 'tsv' ? '\t' : '' });%0A  if (res.errors.length) warn('PapaParse reported errors:', res.errors.slice(0, 3));%0A  const delim = (res.meta && res.meta.delimiter) || ',';%0A  const rows = res.data.map(r => (Array.isArray(r) ? r : [r]).map(c => String(c ?? '')));%0A  log(`Parsed ${formatLabel(format)} text (${text.length} chars) with PapaParse — delimiter ${JSON.stringify(delim)}, ${rows.length} rows`);%0A  return rows;%0A}%0A%0A/* ---- Parser: workbooks (XLSX / XLS / ODS / XLSB) via SheetJS ---- */%0Aasync function parseWorkbook(buf, sheetPick) {%0A  log(`Parsing workbook (${buf.byteLength} bytes) with SheetJS${sheetPick ? `, sheet "${sheetPick}"` : ''}`);%0A  // `await` on purpose: the real SheetJS resolves synchronously, but a%0A  // dependency-free reader (the bookmarklet build) inflates asynchronously.%0A  const wb = await XLSX.read(buf, { type: 'array' });%0A  const name = sheetPick && wb.SheetNames.includes(sheetPick) ? sheetPick : wb.SheetNames[0];%0A  const ws = wb.Sheets[name];%0A  const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, { header: 1, raw: false, defval: '' })%0A    .map(row => row.map(c => String(c ?? '')));%0A  log(`Workbook parsed: ${wb.SheetNames.length} sheet(s), loaded "${name}" — ${rows.length} rows`);%0A  return { rows, sheetName: name };%0A}%0A%0A/* ---- Parser: JSON (array of objects, array of arrays, wrapped array, NDJSON) ---- */%0Afunction jsonScalar(v) {%0A  if (v === null || v === undefined) return '';%0A  return typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v);%0A}%0A%0A/** Array of objects → header row (union of keys, first-seen order) + data rows. */%0Afunction jsonObjectsToMatrix(objs) {%0A  const keys = [], seen = new Set();%0A  for (const o of objs) {%0A    if (!o || typeof o !== 'object' || Array.isArray(o)) continue;%0A    for (const k of Object.keys(o)) if (!seen.has(k)) { seen.add(k); keys.push(k); }%0A  }%0A  if (!keys.length) return null;%0A  return [keys, ...objs.map(o => keys.map(k => jsonScalar(o && typeof o === 'object' ? o[k] : '')))];%0A}%0A%0A/** First array nested anywhere inside an object, e.g. {items:[…]} or {data:{rows:[…]}}. */%0Afunction findJsonArray(value, depth = 0) {%0A  if (depth > 4 || !value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) return null;%0A  for (const v of Object.values(value)) if (Array.isArray(v) && v.length) return v;%0A  for (const v of Object.values(value)) {%0A    const hit = findJsonArray(v, depth + 1);%0A    if (hit) return hit;%0A  }%0A  return null;%0A}%0A%0Afunction jsonToMatrix(value) {%0A  let v = value;%0A  if (!Array.isArray(v)) {%0A    if (v && typeof v === 'object') {%0A      const inner = findJsonArray(v);%0A      if (inner) { log('JSON: unwrapped a single nested array (e.g. {items:[…]})'); v = inner; }%0A      else {%0A        const vals = Object.values(v);%0A        if (vals.length && vals.every(x => x && typeof x === 'object' && !Array.isArray(x))) {%0A          log(`JSON: an object map with ${vals.length} entries → records, keys kept as _key`);%0A          return jsonObjectsToMatrix(Object.entries(v).map(([k, o]) => ({ _key: k, ...o })));%0A        }%0A        log('JSON: a single object → one record');%0A        return jsonObjectsToMatrix([v]);%0A      }%0A    } else {%0A      return [['Value'], [jsonScalar(v)]];%0A    }%0A  }%0A  if (!v.length) return [];%0A  if (v.every(Array.isArray)) {%0A    log(`JSON: array of ${v.length} arrays → rows verbatim`);%0A    return v.map(r => r.map(jsonScalar));%0A  }%0A  if (v.every(x => x && typeof x === 'object' && !Array.isArray(x))) {%0A    const m = jsonObjectsToMatrix(v);%0A    if (m) { log(`JSON: array of ${v.length} objects → ${m[0].length} columns`); return m; }%0A  }%0A  log(`JSON: array of ${v.length} scalars → single Value column`);%0A  return [['Value'], ...v.map(x => [jsonScalar(x)])];%0A}%0A%0Afunction parseJsonText(text) {%0A  let parsed;%0A  try {%0A    parsed = JSON.parse(String(text).replace(/^\uFEFF/, ''));%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    // JSON Lines / NDJSON: one object per line is a very common export shape.%0A    const lines = String(text).trim().split(/\r?\n/).filter(l => l.trim());%0A    const objs = lines.length > 1 && lines.every(l => /^\s*[\[{]/.test(l))%0A      ? lines.map(l => { try { return JSON.parse(l); } catch { return null; } })%0A      : [];%0A    if (!objs.length || !objs.every(Boolean)) throw new Error(`invalid JSON (${e.message})`);%0A    log(`JSON.parse failed — recovered as NDJSON (${objs.length} lines)`);%0A    return jsonToMatrix(objs);%0A  }%0A  const rows = jsonToMatrix(parsed);%0A  log(`JSON parsed: ${rows.length} rows × ${rows.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, r.length), 0)} cols`);%0A  return rows;%0A}%0A%0A/* ---- Parser: HTML tables (and, for local picks, plain link lists) ---- */%0A/** Rows of a <table> → rectangular grid, honouring rowspan/colspan. */%0Afunction tableToMatrix(table) {%0A  const own = (el) => el.closest('table') === table; // ignore nested tables%0A  const trs = [...table.querySelectorAll('tr')].filter(own);%0A  const grid = [];%0A  trs.forEach((tr, r) => {%0A    grid[r] = grid[r] || [];%0A    let col = 0;%0A    for (const cell of [...tr.querySelectorAll('th, td')].filter(own)) {%0A      while (grid[r][col] !== undefined) col++;%0A      const cs = Math.max(1, parseInt(cell.getAttribute('colspan') || '1', 10) || 1);%0A      const rs = Math.max(1, parseInt(cell.getAttribute('rowspan') || '1', 10) || 1);%0A      const text = cell.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();%0A      for (let dr = 0; dr < rs; dr++) {%0A        grid[r + dr] = grid[r + dr] || [];%0A        for (let dc = 0; dc < cs; dc++) {%0A          if (grid[r + dr][col + dc] === undefined) grid[r + dr][col + dc] = dr === 0 && dc === 0 ? text : '';%0A        }%0A      }%0A      col += cs;%0A    }%0A  });%0A  return grid%0A    .filter(row => row && row.some(c => c !== undefined && c !== ''))%0A    .map(row => { const out = []; for (let i = 0; i < row.length; i++) out[i] = String(row[i] ?? ''); return out; });%0A}%0A%0Afunction parseHtmlText(text, { allowLinkFallback = true } = {}) {%0A  // parseFromString yields an inert document: no scripts run, no images fetch.%0A  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(String(text), 'text/html');%0A  // Only consider top-level tables; a nested table is almost always layout filler.%0A  const tables = [...doc.querySelectorAll('table')].filter(t => !(t.parentElement && t.parentElement.closest('table')));%0A  let best = null, bestScore = 0;%0A  for (const t of tables) {%0A    const m = tableToMatrix(t);%0A    const score = m.length * m.reduce((w, r) => Math.max(w, r.length), 0);%0A    if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = m; }%0A  }%0A  if (best && best.length >= 2) {%0A    log(`HTML parsed: picked the largest of ${tables.length} table(s) — ${best.length} rows × ${best.reduce((w, r) => Math.max(w, r.length), 0)} cols`);%0A    return best;%0A  }%0A  if (!allowLinkFallback) throw new Error('that URL returned a web page with no data table in it');%0A  // Saved bookmarks pages and link round-ups are lists, not tables.%0A  const seen = new Set(), links = [];%0A  for (const a of doc.querySelectorAll('a[href]')) {%0A    const href = a.getAttribute('href') || '';%0A    if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(href) || seen.has(href)) continue;%0A    seen.add(href);%0A    links.push([a.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() || href, href]);%0A  }%0A  if (links.length) {%0A    log(`HTML parsed: no usable table — harvested ${links.length} http(s) link(s) from <a href>`);%0A    return [['Name', 'URL'], ...links];%0A  }%0A  throw new Error('no <table> rows and no http(s) links found');%0A}%0A%0A/* ---- Parser: XML (RSS/Atom feeds, sitemaps, OPML, generic record lists) ---- */%0Aconst XML_RECORD_TAGS = /^(item|entry|record|row|link|url|post|article|result|job|task|page|doc|node|member|place|event|product|book)$/i;%0A%0A/** The element name that most looks like a repeated record in this document.%0A    Record containers (elements that hold fields) beat leaf elements — otherwise an%0A    RSS feed would tabulate its <link> elements instead of its <item> elements. */%0Afunction pickXmlRecordTag(doc) {%0A  const seen = new Map(); // tagName → { count, containers }%0A  for (const el of doc.querySelectorAll('*')) {%0A    const n = el.tagName;%0A    const rec = seen.get(n) || { count: 0, containers: 0 };%0A    rec.count++;%0A    if (el.children.length) rec.containers++;%0A    seen.set(n, rec);%0A  }%0A  const repeated = [...seen.entries()]%0A    .filter(([n, r]) => r.count >= 2 && !/^(html|head|body|script|style)$/i.test(n))%0A    .map(([n, r]) => ({ tag: n, ...r, known: XML_RECORD_TAGS.test(n) }));%0A  if (!repeated.length) return null;%0A  const rank = (a, b) => (b.known - a.known) || (b.count - a.count);%0A  const containers = repeated.filter(r => r.containers === r.count).sort(rank);%0A  if (containers.length) return containers[0].tag;%0A  return repeated.sort(rank)[0].tag;%0A}%0A%0A/** Text of a leaf element — falling back to its url-ish attribute (Atom <link href>). */%0Afunction xmlLeafValue(el) {%0A  const text = el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();%0A  if (text) return text;%0A  for (const a of ['href', 'url', 'src', 'loc']) {%0A    const v = el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute(a);%0A    if (v) return v;%0A  }%0A  return [...(el.attributes || [])].map(a => a.value).join(' ');%0A}%0A%0Afunction xmlElementToRecord(el) {%0A  const rec = {};%0A  // Attributes first so href/url land in an early column.%0A  for (const attr of el.attributes || []) rec[attr.name] = attr.value;%0A  const kids = [...el.children];%0A  if (!kids.length && !Object.keys(rec).length) rec.value = xmlLeafValue(el);%0A  for (const k of kids) {%0A    const val = k.children.length ? JSON.stringify(xmlToPlain(k)) : xmlLeafValue(k);%0A    rec[k.tagName] = rec[k.tagName] === undefined ? val : `${rec[k.tagName]}; ${val}`;%0A  }%0A  return rec;%0A}%0Afunction xmlToPlain(el) {%0A  const o = {};%0A  for (const attr of el.attributes || []) o[attr.name] = attr.value;%0A  const kids = [...el.children];%0A  if (!kids.length) o.value = xmlLeafValue(el);%0A  for (const k of kids) o[k.tagName] = k.children.length ? xmlToPlain(k) : xmlLeafValue(k);%0A  return o;%0A}%0A%0Afunction parseXmlText(text) {%0A  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(String(text), 'application/xml');%0A  if (doc.querySelector('parsererror')) throw new Error('XML is not well-formed');%0A  const tag = pickXmlRecordTag(doc);%0A  if (!tag) throw new Error('no repeated record elements to turn into rows');%0A  const els = [...doc.querySelectorAll(tag)];%0A  log(`XML parsed: ${els.length} <${tag}> record element(s)`);%0A  const recs = els.map(xmlElementToRecord);%0A  const keys = [];%0A  for (const r of recs) for (const k of Object.keys(r)) if (!keys.includes(k)) keys.push(k);%0A  return [keys, ...recs.map(r => keys.map(k => jsonScalar(r[k])))];%0A}%0A%0A/** Detect + parse any supported buffer into a matrix. Throws a friendly error for the rest. */%0Aasync function parseDetected(buf, det, sheetPick, htmlOpts) {%0A  const format = det.format;%0A  if (format === 'pdf') {%0A    throw new Error('PDF is not supported yet — export the list to CSV/XLSX first');%0A  }%0A  if (isWorkbookFormat(format)) {%0A    if (!HAS_XLSX) throw new Error(`${formatLabel(format)} needs workbook support, which this build does not include — load a CSV, TSV, JSON, HTML or XML list instead`);%0A    const { rows, sheetName } = await parseWorkbook(buf, sheetPick);%0A    return { rows, sheetName, format };%0A  }%0A  const text = new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(buf);%0A  const rows = format === 'json' ? parseJsonText(text)%0A    : format === 'html' ? parseHtmlText(text, htmlOpts)%0A    : format === 'xml' ? parseXmlText(text)%0A    : parseDelimitedText(text, format);%0A  return { rows, sheetName: null, format };%0A}%0A%0A/** Pick a header column: an exact word ("Completed") outranks a prefix match%0A    ("Completed on", "Notes / comments"). Returns -1 when nothing matches. */%0Afunction pickColumn(header, exactWords, re) {%0A  const exact = header.findIndex(h => exactWords.has(normalizeHeader(h)));%0A  return exact >= 0 ? exact : header.findIndex(h => re.test(h));%0A}%0A%0A/** Detect header row + column roles from a 2D matrix. */%0Afunction analyzeMatrix(data) {%0A  // Trim fully-empty trailing rows%0A  while (data.length && data[data.length - 1].every(c => !String(c).trim())) data.pop();%0A%0A  const width = data.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, r.length), 1);%0A  const first = (data[0] || []).map(c => String(c).trim());%0A%0A  // Header heuristic: known header words, or a first row with no URL values while later rows have URLs.%0A  const firstRowHasUrl = first.some(c => URL_VALUE_RE.test(c));%0A  const hasHeader = first.some(c => HEADER_URL_RE.test(c) || HEADER_NAME_RE.test(c) || HEADER_STATUS_RE.test(c) || HEADER_NOTES_RE.test(c))%0A    || (!firstRowHasUrl && data.slice(1, 51).some(r => r.some(c => URL_VALUE_RE.test(String(c)))));%0A%0A  const header = hasHeader ? first : [];%0A  let urlCol = -1, nameCol = -1, statusCol = -1, notesCol = -1;%0A%0A  if (hasHeader) {%0A    header.forEach((h, i) => {%0A      if (urlCol < 0 && HEADER_URL_RE.test(h)) urlCol = i;%0A      if (nameCol < 0 && HEADER_NAME_RE.test(h)) nameCol = i;%0A    });%0A    statusCol = pickColumn(header, STATUS_HEADER_WORDS, HEADER_STATUS_RE);%0A    notesCol = pickColumn(header, NOTES_HEADER_WORDS, HEADER_NOTES_RE);%0A  }%0A  // Fallback URL column: the column with the most http-prefixed values in the first 50 rows.%0A  if (urlCol < 0) {%0A    let best = -1, bestCount = 0;%0A    for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) {%0A      let n = 0;%0A      for (let r = hasHeader ? 1 : 0; r < Math.min(data.length, 50); r++) if (URL_VALUE_RE.test(String(data[r][c] || '').trim())) n++;%0A      if (n > bestCount) { bestCount = n; best = c; }%0A    }%0A    urlCol = bestCount > 0 ? best : 0;%0A  }%0A  // Fallback name column: first non-URL column with any text.%0A  if (nameCol < 0) {%0A    for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) {%0A      if (c === urlCol) continue;%0A      if (data.some(r => String(r[c] || '').trim())) { nameCol = c; break; }%0A    }%0A  }%0A  log(`Matrix analyzed: header=${hasHeader}, urlCol=${urlCol}, nameCol=${nameCol}, statusCol=${statusCol}, notesCol=${notesCol}, width=${width}`);%0A  return { hasHeader, urlCol, nameCol, statusCol, notesCol, width };%0A}%0A%0A/** Load a normalized 2D matrix into app state. */%0Afunction loadMatrix(data, meta) {%0A  log(`loadMatrix: ${data.length} rows from "${meta.name}" (mode=${meta.mode}, ext=${meta.ext})`);%0A  const a = analyzeMatrix(data);%0A  const bodyRows = data.length - (a.hasHeader ? 1 : 0);%0A%0A  state.name = meta.name;%0A  state.ext = meta.ext;%0A  state.mode = meta.mode;%0A  state.fileHandle = meta.handle || null;%0A  state.sourceUrl = meta.sourceUrl || null;%0A  state.sheetName = meta.sheetName || 'Sheet1';%0A  state.data = data;%0A  Object.assign(state, a);%0A%0A  // Seed per-card status/notes. Priority: explicit session restore > the file's%0A  // own Status/Notes columns (round-trip) > blank state.%0A  const n = bodyRows;%0A  const fileHasCols = a.hasHeader && (a.statusCol >= 0 || a.notesCol >= 0);%0A  const headerRow = data[0] || [];%0A  const statusName = a.statusCol >= 0 ? String(headerRow[a.statusCol] || 'Status') : 'Status';%0A  const notesName  = a.notesCol  >= 0 ? String(headerRow[a.notesCol]  || 'Notes')  : 'Notes';%0A  const seeded = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => {%0A    const row = data[i + (a.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || [];%0A    const raw = a.statusCol >= 0 ? String(row[a.statusCol] || '').trim() : '';%0A    return isCompleteValue(raw) ? 'complete' : 'incomplete';%0A  });%0A  const seededNotes = a.hasHeader && a.notesCol >= 0%0A    ? Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => String((data[i + (a.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || [])[a.notesCol] ?? ''))%0A    : null;%0A  const restoring = Array.isArray(meta.status) && meta.status.length === n;%0A  state.status = restoring ? meta.status.slice() : seeded;%0A  state.notes  = restoring ? (Array.isArray(meta.notes) && meta.notes.length === n ? meta.notes.slice() : Array(n).fill(''))%0A               : (seededNotes || Array(n).fill(''));%0A%0A  // Round-trip resume: an exported/updated file dropped back in carries the%0A  // user's progress in its completed status + notes columns. Report what was%0A  // picked up so "continue where you left off" is visible, not silent.%0A  const seededDone = seeded.filter(s => s === 'complete').length;%0A  const seededWithNotes = seededNotes ? seededNotes.filter(s => String(s).trim()).length : 0;%0A  const resumed = [];%0A  if (!restoring && fileHasCols) {%0A    if (a.statusCol >= 0) {%0A      log(`Seeded ${seededDone} 'complete' status(es) from the file's ${statusName} column (round-trip)`);%0A      if (seededDone) resumed.push(`${seededDone} complete`);%0A    }%0A    if (a.notesCol >= 0) {%0A      log(`Seeded ${seededWithNotes} note(s) from the file's ${notesName} column (round-trip)`);%0A      if (seededWithNotes) resumed.push(`${seededWithNotes} note${seededWithNotes === 1 ? '' : 's'}`);%0A    }%0A  }%0A%0A  state.isDirty = false;%0A  closeAllTabs();%0A  els.search.value = ''; state.search = '';%0A  els.showCompleted.checked = false; state.hideCompleted = true;  // completed hidden by default%0A  state.sortCol = null; state.sortAsc = true; els.sortDir.textContent = '↓';%0A  state.expanded = {};%0A  applyLayoutFor(state.data[0] || []);   // auto-apply a saved preset when the header matches%0A  buildSortOptions();%0A%0A  updateChrome();%0A  renderCards();%0A  els.welcome.hidden = true;%0A  els.welcome.style.display = 'none';%0A  maybeShowFirstRunPicker();%0A  const noun = `task${n === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;%0A  toast(`Loaded ${n} ${noun} from ${state.name}${resumed.length ? ` — resumed ${resumed.join(' · ')}` : ''}`, 'success');%0A}%0A%0A/* ----------------------- First-run open-mode picker ----------------------- */%0Aconst LS_SEEN_PICKER = 'turnstone-mode-picked';%0A%0Afunction maybeShowFirstRunPicker() {%0A  let seen = false;%0A  try { seen = localStorage.getItem(LS_SEEN_PICKER) === '1'; } catch (e) {}%0A  if (seen) return;%0A  showModePicker(true);%0A}%0A%0A/** Ask the user how links should open (first run, or later via the menu). */%0Afunction showModePicker(firstRun) {%0A  log(`Showing open-mode picker (firstRun=${firstRun})`);%0A  const overlay = document.createElement('div');%0A  overlay.id = 'mode-picker';%0A  overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:300;padding:20px';%0A  const opts = Object.entries(OPEN_MODES).map(([k, v]) => `%0A    <button data-pick="${k}" style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;text-align:left;width:100%25;margin:6px 0;padding:11px 14px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text)">%0A      <span style="font-weight:600">${v.label}</span>%0A      <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">${v.hint}</span>%0A    </button>`).join('');%0A  overlay.innerHTML = `%0A    <div style="background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:22px;width:380px;max-width:94vw">%0A      <h3 style="margin:0 0 4px;font-size:15px">How do you want to work through your links?</h3>%0A      <p style="margin:0 0 12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">You can change this anytime from the ☰ menu.</p>%0A      ${opts}%0A      <button id="picker-later" style="margin-top:8px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:11.5px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:none;color:var(--muted)">${firstRun ? 'Decide later (tabs by default)' : 'Cancel'}</button>%0A    </div>`;%0A  ROOT.appendChild(overlay);%0A  const done = () => { overlay.remove(); };%0A  overlay.querySelectorAll('button[data-pick]').forEach(b => {%0A    b.onclick = () => {%0A      setOpenMode(b.dataset.pick, false);%0A      try { localStorage.setItem(LS_SEEN_PICKER, '1'); } catch (e) {}%0A      toast(`Links will open as ${OPEN_MODES[b.dataset.pick].label.toLowerCase()}`, 'success');%0A      done();%0A    };%0A  });%0A  overlay.querySelector('%23picker-later').onclick = () => {%0A    try { localStorage.setItem(LS_SEEN_PICKER, '1'); } catch (e) {}%0A    log('Open-mode picker deferred — staying with current mode');%0A    done();%0A  };%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------- Card column layout ----------------------------- */%0Aconst COLLAPSED_COLS = 3;   // data columns shown on a collapsed card%0Aconst LS_PRESETS = 'turnstone-col-presets';%0A%0A/** Header signature: trimmed, lowercased header values joined with '¦'. */%0Afunction headerSignature(headerRow) {%0A  return (headerRow || []).map(h => String(h || '').trim().toLowerCase()).join('¦');%0A}%0A%0Afunction loadPresets() {%0A  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(LS_PRESETS) || '{}'); }%0A  catch (e) { warn('Could not read column presets', e); return {}; }%0A}%0A%0Afunction savePresets(p) {%0A  try { localStorage.setItem(LS_PRESETS, JSON.stringify(p)); return true; }%0A  catch (e) { warn('Could not persist column presets', e); return false; }%0A}%0A%0A/** If a saved preset matches this file's header exactly, apply its layout. */%0Afunction applyLayoutFor(headerRow) {%0A  const width = (state.data[0] || []).length;%0A  if (!width) return;%0A  const sig = headerSignature(headerRow);%0A  const presets = loadPresets();%0A  const preset = sig && presets[sig];%0A  if (preset && Array.isArray(preset.colOrder)) {%0A    const valid = preset.colOrder.filter(c => Number.isInteger(c) && c >= 0 && c < width);%0A    for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) if (!valid.includes(c)) valid.push(c); // tolerate schema drift%0A    state.colOrder = valid;%0A    state.colHidden = {};%0A    for (const c of preset.hidden || []) if (c >= 0 && c < width) state.colHidden[c] = true;%0A    log(`Preset "${preset.name}" auto-applied (header signature matched)`);%0A    toast(`Layout preset "${preset.name}" applied`, 'success');%0A  } else {%0A    state.colOrder = null;%0A    state.colHidden = {};%0A    log('No matching layout preset for this header — using file order');%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/** Data-column display order for cards (fixed roles excluded). */%0Afunction cardColumns() {%0A  const width = state.data.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, r.length), 0);%0A  const fixed = new Set([state.urlCol, state.nameCol, state.statusCol, state.notesCol].filter(c => c >= 0));%0A  const all = [];%0A  for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) if (!fixed.has(c)) all.push(c);%0A  const order = state.colOrder ? state.colOrder.filter(c => !fixed.has(c) && c < width) : [];%0A  for (const c of all) if (!order.includes(c)) order.push(c); // append anything the preset didn't mention%0A  return order.filter(c => !state.colHidden[c]);%0A}%0A%0Afunction colLabel(c) {%0A  if (state.hasHeader) return String((state.data[0] || [])[c] || '').trim() || `Column ${c + 1}`;%0A  return `Column ${c + 1}`;%0A}%0A%0Afunction visibleCardCount() { return cardColumns().length; }%0A%0A/* ------------------------------ Settings UI -------------------------------- */%0Afunction openSettings() {%0A  log('Opening column settings');%0A  renderSettings();%0A  els.settingsOverlay.hidden = false;%0A}%0Afunction closeSettings() { els.settingsOverlay.hidden = true; }%0A%0Afunction renderSettings() {%0A  const width = state.data.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, r.length), 0);%0A  const fixed = new Set([state.urlCol, state.nameCol, state.statusCol, state.notesCol].filter(c => c >= 0));%0A  const roles = { [state.urlCol]: 'URL', [state.nameCol]: 'name', [state.statusCol]: 'status', [state.notesCol]: 'notes' };%0A  const order = state.colOrder ? state.colOrder.filter(c => c < width) : [];%0A  for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) if (!order.includes(c)) order.push(c);%0A%0A  const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();%0A  for (const c of order) {%0A    const div = document.createElement('div');%0A    div.className = 'set-col' + (fixed.has(c) ? ' fixed' : '');%0A    div.draggable = !fixed.has(c);%0A    div.dataset.col = c;%0A    div.innerHTML = fixed.has(c)%0A      ? `<span class="drag">⋮⋮</span><em>${esc(String(roles[c] || '').toUpperCase())}</em> <span>${esc(colLabel(c))}</span><span class="pos">card feature</span>`%0A      : `<span class="drag" title="Drag to reorder">⋮⋮</span>%0A         <label><input type="checkbox" data-colshow="${c}" ${state.colHidden[c] ? '' : 'checked'}> ${esc(colLabel(c))}</label>%0A         <span class="pos">%23${order.indexOf(c) + 1}</span>`;%0A    frag.appendChild(div);%0A  }%0A  if (!order.length) els.settingsCols.innerHTML = '<p class="hint">No extra columns — every column in this file is a fixed card feature.</p>';%0A  else { els.settingsCols.innerHTML = ''; els.settingsCols.appendChild(frag); }%0A%0A  const presets = loadPresets();%0A  const sig = headerSignature(state.hasHeader ? state.data[0] : []);%0A  els.settingsPresets.innerHTML = '';%0A  const entries = Object.entries(presets);%0A  if (!entries.length) { els.settingsPresets.innerHTML = '<p class="hint">No presets saved yet.</p>'; }%0A  for (const [s, p] of entries) {%0A    const row = document.createElement('div');%0A    row.className = 'preset-row';%0A    row.innerHTML = `<span class="pname">${esc(p.name)}</span>%0A      <span class="pmeta">${(p.colOrder || []).length} columns · ${p.hidden?.length ? p.hidden.length + ' hidden' : 'none hidden'}${s === sig ? ' · matches this file' : ''}</span>%0A      <button class="btn" data-preset-apply="${esc(s)}" ${s === sig ? 'disabled' : ''}>Apply here</button>%0A      <button class="icon" data-preset-del="${esc(s)}" title="Delete preset">🗑</button>`;%0A    els.settingsPresets.appendChild(row);%0A  }%0A}%0A%0Afunction savePreset() {%0A  if (!state.hasHeader) { toast('This file has no header row — presets need column names', 'error'); return; }%0A  const name = els.presetName.value.trim();%0A  if (!name) { toast('Give the preset a name first', 'error'); return; }%0A  const width = state.data.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, r.length), 0);%0A  const order = state.colOrder ? state.colOrder.filter(c => c < width) : [];%0A  for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) if (!order.includes(c)) order.push(c);%0A  const hidden = Object.keys(state.colHidden).map(Number).filter(c => c < width);%0A  const sig = headerSignature(state.data[0]);%0A  const presets = loadPresets();%0A  presets[sig] = { name, colOrder: order, hidden, ts: Date.now() };%0A  if (savePresets(presets)) {%0A    log(`Column preset "${name}" saved for header signature (${sig.split('¦').length} cols)`);%0A    toast(`Preset "${name}" saved — files with this exact header auto-apply it`, 'success');%0A    els.presetName.value = '';%0A    renderSettings();%0A  } else toast('Could not save preset (storage unavailable?)', 'error');%0A}%0A%0Afunction applyPresetByKey(sig) {%0A  const p = loadPresets()[sig];%0A  if (!p) return;%0A  state.colOrder = (p.colOrder || []).slice();%0A  state.colHidden = {};%0A  for (const c of p.hidden || []) state.colHidden[c] = true;%0A  state.expanded = {};%0A  log(`Preset "${p.name}" applied manually`);%0A  renderCards();%0A  renderSettings();%0A}%0A%0Afunction resetColLayout() {%0A  state.colOrder = null;%0A  state.colHidden = {};%0A  state.expanded = {};%0A  log('Column layout reset to file order');%0A  renderCards();%0A  renderSettings();%0A}%0A%0A/** Read a File/Blob (picked locally) and load it. */%0Aasync function loadFromFileObject(file, handle) {%0A  state.sourceUrl = null; // local picks are not shareable via ?file=%0A  log(`Reading picked file "${file.name}" (${file.size} bytes, type="${file.type || 'unknown'}", fsHandle=${!!handle})`);%0A  try {%0A    const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();%0A    const det = detectFormat(buf, file.name, file.type);%0A    const { rows: matrix, sheetName } = await parseDetected(buf, det, null, { allowLinkFallback: true });%0A    if (!matrix.length) { toast('File appears to be empty', 'error'); warn('Empty file:', file.name); return; }%0A    // Only formats we can rebuild get silent write-back; the rest import one-way.%0A    const writable = canWrite(det.format);%0A    if (!writable) {%0A      log(`"${det.format}" is import-only — write-back disabled, edits persist to ${storageLabel()}`);%0A      toast(`${formatLabel(det.format)} imports as a one-way conversion — your edits save to ${storageLabel()}. Use Export to keep them.`, 'success');%0A    }%0A    const keep = writable && !!handle;%0A    loadMatrix(matrix, { name: file.name, ext: det.format, mode: keep ? 'fs' : 'fallback', handle: keep ? handle : null, sheetName });%0A    await rememberFile(keep ? { key: 'active', kind: 'fs', name: file.name, ts: Date.now(), handle }%0A                            : { key: 'active', kind: 'fallback', name: file.name, ts: Date.now(), handle: null });%0A    scheduleSave(0); // persist a session snapshot right away (fallback modes)%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    err('Failed to load file', file.name, e);%0A    toast(`Could not parse "${file.name}": ${e.message}`, 'error');%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/* ---------------------- Drag & drop initial acquisition ------------------- */%0A/** True when a drag is carrying files from the OS (not an in-page drag like the%0A    settings panel's column reordering, which must stay untouched). */%0Afunction isFileDrag(e) {%0A  return [...((e.dataTransfer && e.dataTransfer.types) || [])].includes('Files');%0A}%0A%0A/** Chromium hands dropped files a real handle, which can restore silent write-back.%0A    Resolve it only when it is already writable — no surprise permission dialog on drop. */%0Aasync function handleFromDrop(dt) {%0A  const item = [...(dt.items || [])].find(i => i.kind === 'file' && typeof i.getAsFileSystemHandle === 'function');%0A  if (!item) return null;%0A  try {%0A    const handle = await item.getAsFileSystemHandle();%0A    if (!handle || handle.kind !== 'file') return null;%0A    if (!handle.queryPermission) return handle;%0A    const state = await handle.queryPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });%0A    if (state === 'granted') { log(`Dropped file "${handle.name}" is writable → silent write-back enabled`); return handle; }%0A    log('Dropped file handle is read-only — edits will go to browser storage (use the drop zone→picker, or Open file…, for live write-back)');%0A    return null;%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    warn('Could not read a file handle from the drop', e);%0A    return null;%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/** Load the file(s) of a drop. Extra files are reported rather than silently ignored. */%0Aasync function handleDroppedFiles(dt) {%0A  const files = [...(dt.files || [])];%0A  if (!files.length) return;%0A  if (files.length > 1) warn(`Drop carried ${files.length} files — loading the first one ("${files[0].name}")`);%0A  const file = files[0];%0A  log(`Dropped file "${file.name}" (${file.size} bytes, type="${file.type || 'unknown'}")`);%0A  toast(`Reading ${file.name}…`);%0A  await loadFromFileObject(file, await handleFromDrop(dt));%0A}%0A%0A/** If this exact file was previously worked on in fallback mode, reuse its statuses/notes. */%0Aasync function readSessionMetaFor(name) {%0A  try {%0A    const sess = await idbGet('session', 'session');%0A    if (sess && sess.name === name) { log('Found prior fallback session for', name); return sess; }%0A  } catch (e) { warn('No session meta', e); }%0A  return null;%0A}%0A%0A/* --------------------------- File acquisition ---------------------------- */%0Aconst FS_PICK_OPTS = {%0A  types: [{%0A    description: 'Link list (CSV, TSV, XLSX, XLS, ODS, JSON, HTML, XML)',%0A    accept: {%0A      'text/csv': ['.csv', '.tsv', '.tab', '.txt'],%0A      'text/plain': ['.csv', '.tsv', '.txt'],%0A      'application/json': ['.json', '.jsonl', '.ndjson'],%0A      'text/html': ['.html', '.htm'],%0A      'application/xml': ['.xml', '.rss', '.atom', '.opml'],%0A      'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet': ['.xlsx', '.xlsm'],%0A      'application/vnd.ms-excel': ['.xls', '.xlsb'],%0A      'application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet': ['.ods'],%0A    },%0A  }],%0A  excludeAcceptAllOption: false,%0A  multiple: false,%0A};%0A%0Aasync function openLocalFile() {%0A  log(`Open file requested. showOpenFilePicker available: ${!!window.showOpenFilePicker}`);%0A  if (window.showOpenFilePicker) {%0A    try {%0A      const [handle] = await window.showOpenFilePicker(FS_PICK_OPTS);%0A      log('File handle acquired:', handle.name);%0A      const file = await handle.getFile();%0A      await loadFromFileObject(file, handle);%0A    } catch (e) {%0A      if (e.name === 'AbortError') { log('File picker aborted by user'); return; }%0A      err('showOpenFilePicker failed, using fallback input', e);%0A      els.fileInput.click();%0A    }%0A  } else {%0A    log('File System Access API unavailable → <input type=file> fallback');%0A    els.fileInput.click();%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/** Load a remote file from ?file=/?url= param or the welcome-panel input. */%0A%0Aasync function loadFromUrl(fileUrl) {%0A  fileUrl = String(fileUrl || '').trim();%0A  let parsed;%0A  try {%0A    parsed = new URL(fileUrl, location.href);%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    toast('That does not look like a valid URL', 'error');%0A    warn('URL parse failed for', fileUrl, e);%0A    return;%0A  }%0A  if (!/^https?:$/.test(parsed.protocol)) { toast('Only http(s) URLs can be fetched', 'error'); return; }%0A  // Bare words resolve as relative URLs — require a scheme or at least a dot before wasting a fetch.%0A  if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9+.\-]*:/i.test(fileUrl) && !fileUrl.includes('.')) {%0A    toast('That does not look like a valid URL', 'error');%0A    warn('Rejected non-URL input:', fileUrl);%0A    return;%0A  }%0A  if (parsed.href === location.href) { toast('That URL is this app itself — paste a data file URL', 'error'); return; }%0A%0A  log(`Loading remote file: ${fileUrl}`);%0A  toast(`Fetching ${parsed.pathname.split('/').pop() || parsed.host}…`);%0A  els.btnLoadUrl.disabled = true;%0A  try {%0A    const res = await fetch(fileUrl, { redirect: 'follow' });%0A    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);%0A    const buf = await res.arrayBuffer();%0A    log(`Fetched ${buf.byteLength} bytes (content-type: ${res.headers.get('content-type') || 'unknown'})`);%0A%0A    // Format detection: magic bytes first, then content sniffing, then URL extension and Content-Type.%0A    const det = detectFormat(buf, parsed.pathname, res.headers.get('content-type'));%0A%0A    // Guard: many hosts serve an HTML error/landing page with HTTP 200. Remote HTML is%0A    // only believed when it really carries a table — never its navigation link list.%0A    if (det.format === 'html' && det.ext !== 'html' && det.ext !== 'htm') {%0A      throw new Error(det.ext%0A        ? `that URL returned a web page, not a ${det.ext.toUpperCase()} file`%0A        : 'that URL returned a web page — paste a direct link to a data file instead');%0A    }%0A%0A    let { rows: matrix, sheetName } = await parseDetected(buf, det, null, { allowLinkFallback: false });%0A    if (isWorkbookFormat(det.format) && await wbHasMultipleSheets(buf)) {%0A      const pick = await pickSheetName(buf, sheetName);%0A      if (pick === null) { log('User cancelled sheet picker — load aborted'); return; }%0A      ({ rows: matrix, sheetName } = await parseDetected(buf, det, pick));%0A    }%0A    if (!matrix.length) { toast('Remote file appears to be empty', 'error'); return; }%0A%0A    // If this URL was worked on before in fallback mode, restore its statuses/notes (round-trip for remote files).%0A    const meta = await readSessionMetaFor(fileUrl);%0A    loadMatrix(matrix, { name: parsed.pathname.split('/').pop() || parsed.host, ext: det.format, mode: 'remote', sheetName, sourceUrl: fileUrl, status: meta?.status, notes: meta?.notes });%0A    await rememberFile({ key: 'active', kind: 'url', name: state.name, ts: Date.now(), handle: null, url: fileUrl });%0A    scheduleSave(0);%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    err('Remote file load failed', e);%0A    // Only network problems get the fetch/CORS framing; parse and format errors%0A    // (unsupported format, HTML error page, malformed XML) speak for themselves.%0A    if (/Failed to fetch|NetworkError|load failed/i.test(String(e.message))) {%0A      toast(`Fetch failed: ${e.message}. The host may block cross-origin reads (CORS) — or the URL is unreachable.`, 'error');%0A    } else {%0A      toast(String(e.message), 'error');%0A    }%0A  } finally {%0A    els.btnLoadUrl.disabled = false;%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/** Sheet-name list for the workbook behind `buf` (SheetJS returns an array OR {SheetNames}). */%0Aasync function sheetNamesOf(buf) {%0A  if (!HAS_XLSX) return [];%0A  const info = await XLSX.read(buf, { type: 'array', bookSheets: true });%0A  return Array.isArray(info) ? info : (info && info.SheetNames) || [];%0A}%0A%0A/** True when the workbook behind `buf` has more than one sheet. */%0Aasync function wbHasMultipleSheets(buf) {%0A  try { return (await sheetNamesOf(buf)).length > 1; }%0A  catch (e) { warn('Could not inspect sheet list', e); return false; }%0A}%0A%0A/** Ask the user which worksheet to load (only for multi-sheet workbooks). Returns null when cancelled. */%0Afunction pickSheetName(buf, current) {%0A  return new Promise(async (resolve) => {%0A    const names = await sheetNamesOf(buf);%0A    log(`Multi-sheet workbook detected: [${names.join(', ')}]`);%0A    const overlay = document.createElement('div');%0A    overlay.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:999';%0A    overlay.innerHTML = `%0A      <div style="background:var(--panel);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:22px;min-width:280px">%0A        <h3 style="margin:0 0 4px;font-size:15px">Multiple sheets found</h3>%0A        <p style="margin:0 0 12px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">Which worksheet holds your task list?</p>%0A        ${names.map(n => `<button data-sheet="${esc(n)}" style="display:block;width:100%25;text-align:left;margin:4px 0;padding:7px 12px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--bg);color:var(--text)${n === current ? ';border-color:var(--accent-dark);font-weight:600' : ''}">${esc(n)}</button>`).join('')}%0A        <button id="sheet-cancel" style="margin-top:8px;padding:6px 12px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:none;color:var(--muted)">Cancel</button>%0A      </div>`;%0A    ROOT.appendChild(overlay);%0A    overlay.querySelector('%23sheet-cancel').onclick = () => { overlay.remove(); resolve(null); };%0A    overlay.querySelectorAll('button[data-sheet]').forEach(b => { b.onclick = () => { const s = b.dataset.sheet; overlay.remove(); log('User picked sheet:', s); resolve(s); }; });%0A  });%0A}%0A%0A/* --------------------- Restore / recent files (IDB) ---------------------- */%0Aasync function rememberFile(activeRecord) {%0A  try {%0A    await idbPut('handles', activeRecord);%0A    await idbPut('handles', { key: activeRecord.name, kind: activeRecord.kind, name: activeRecord.name, ts: activeRecord.ts, handle: activeRecord.handle });%0A    els.miRestore.hidden = false;%0A    log('File handle remembered in IndexedDB (active + recents)');%0A  } catch (e) { warn('Could not persist file handle', e); }%0A}%0A%0Aasync function restoreLastFile() {%0A  log('Restore Workspace clicked');%0A  try {%0A    const rec = await idbGet('handles', 'active');%0A    if (!rec) { toast('No previous workspace found', 'error'); return; }%0A    if (rec.kind === 'fs' && rec.handle) {%0A      let perm = await rec.handle.queryPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });%0A      log(`Saved handle permission: ${perm}`);%0A      if (perm !== 'granted') {%0A        perm = await rec.handle.requestPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });%0A        log(`Requested handle permission: ${perm}`);%0A      }%0A      if (perm !== 'granted') { toast('Permission denied — pick the file again', 'error'); return; }%0A      const file = await rec.handle.getFile();%0A      await loadFromFileObject(file, rec.handle);%0A    } else {%0A      const sess = await idbGet('session', 'session');%0A      if (!sess || !sess.data) { toast('No saved browser session found', 'error'); return; }%0A      log('Restoring fallback session from IndexedDB:', sess.name);%0A      loadMatrix(sess.data, { name: sess.name, ext: sess.ext || 'csv', mode: 'fallback', sheetName: sess.sheetName, status: sess.status, notes: sess.notes, sourceUrl: sess.sourceUrl || null });%0A      state.isDirty = true; // still needs exporting%0A      updateSaveIndicator();%0A      scheduleSave(0);%0A    }%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    err('Restore failed', e);%0A    toast(`Restore failed: ${e.message}`, 'error');%0A  }%0A}%0A%0Aasync function renderRecents() {%0A  try {%0A    const all = (await idbGetAll('handles')).filter(r => r.name && r.ts).sort((a, b) => b.ts - a.ts).slice(0, 5);%0A    if (!all.length) return;%0A    els.recents.hidden = false;%0A    els.recentsList.innerHTML = '';%0A    for (const r of all) {%0A      const btn = document.createElement('button');%0A      btn.className = 'recent-item';%0A      btn.innerHTML = `<span>📄 ${esc(r.name)}</span><span class="ts">${new Date(r.ts).toLocaleString()}</span>`;%0A      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {%0A        log('Recent file clicked:', r.name);%0A        if (r.kind === 'fs' && r.handle) { restoreHandle(r.handle); }%0A        else if (r.kind === 'url' && r.url) { loadFromUrl(r.url); }%0A        else { restoreLastFile(); }%0A      });%0A      els.recentsList.appendChild(btn);%0A    }%0A    log(`Rendered ${all.length} recent file(s)`);%0A  } catch (e) { warn('Recents render failed', e); }%0A}%0A%0Aasync function restoreHandle(handle) {%0A  try {%0A    let perm = await handle.queryPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });%0A    if (perm !== 'granted') perm = await handle.requestPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });%0A    if (perm !== 'granted') { toast('Permission denied — pick the file again', 'error'); return; }%0A    await loadFromFileObject(await handle.getFile(), handle);%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    err('Recent-file restore failed', e);%0A    toast(`Could not reopen file: ${e.message}`, 'error');%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------------- Rendering ------------------------------- */%0Afunction cardCount() { return state.data.length - (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0); }%0A%0Afunction updateChrome() {%0A  const modeLabels = { fs: 'file write-back ON', fallback: SESSION_ONLY ? 'this tab only — export to keep' : 'fallback: browser storage', remote: 'remote file (read-only source)', demo: 'demo data' };%0A  const has = cardCount() > 0;%0A  // Sidebar header: file name + save state%0A  els.headName.innerHTML = state.name%0A    ? `${esc(state.name)} <span style="color:var(--muted);font-size:10.5px">· ${modeLabels[state.mode] || ''} · ${state.ext.toUpperCase()}</span>`%0A    : '<span class="no-file">No file loaded</span>';%0A  els.headName.title = state.sourceUrl ? `${state.name} — from ${state.sourceUrl}` : (state.name || '');%0A  // Menu item availability%0A  els.miClose.disabled = !state.mode;%0A  els.miLink.disabled = !state.sourceUrl;%0A  els.miExportCsv.disabled = !has;%0A  els.miExportXlsx.disabled = !has || !HAS_XLSX_WRITE;%0A  els.miExportXlsx.hidden = !HAS_XLSX_WRITE;   // no workbook writer → offer only what works%0A  updateSaveIndicator();%0A  renderModeMenu();%0A  renderAutoMenu();%0A}%0A%0Afunction updateSaveIndicator() {%0A  const el = els.headSave;%0A  el.className = '';%0A  if (!state.mode) { el.textContent = ''; return; }%0A  if (state.isDirty) { el.className = 'dirty'; el.textContent = '● unsaved'; }%0A  else if (state.lastSavedAt) {%0A    el.className = 'saved';%0A    el.textContent = `✓ saved ${new Date(state.lastSavedAt).toLocaleTimeString()}`;%0A  } else el.textContent = '';%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------------ Card ordering ----------------------------- */%0Afunction buildSortOptions() {%0A  els.sortCol.innerHTML = '<option value="">File order</option>';%0A  const width = state.data.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, r.length), 0);%0A  const fixed = new Set([state.urlCol, state.nameCol, state.statusCol, state.notesCol].filter(c => c >= 0));%0A  for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) {%0A    const o = document.createElement('option');%0A    o.value = String(c);%0A    o.textContent = (fixed.has(c) ? colLabel(c) + ' *' : colLabel(c));%0A    els.sortCol.appendChild(o);%0A  }%0A  els.sortCol.value = state.sortCol === null ? '' : String(state.sortCol);%0A}%0A%0Afunction sortedIndices() {%0A  const total = cardCount();%0A  const idx = Array.from({ length: total }, (_, i) => i);%0A  if (state.sortCol === null || state.sortCol < 0) return idx;%0A  const c = state.sortCol;%0A  const val = i => String((state.data[i + (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || [])[c] ??
