'').trim();%0A  const numeric = idx.every(i => val(i) === '' || /^-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(val(i)));%0A  idx.sort((a, b) => {%0A    const va = val(a), vb = val(b);%0A    let cmp;%0A    if (numeric) cmp = (parseFloat(va) || 0) - (parseFloat(vb) || 0);%0A    else cmp = va.localeCompare(vb, undefined, { sensitivity: 'base', numeric: true });%0A    return state.sortAsc ? cmp : -cmp;%0A  });%0A  return idx;%0A}%0A%0A/** Next incomplete card in file order after row i (or first, when i is null). */%0Afunction nextIncompleteRow(afterRow) {%0A  const total = cardCount();%0A  const start = afterRow === null || afterRow === undefined ? 0 : afterRow + 1;%0A  for (let j = start; j < total; j++) if ((state.status[j] || 'incomplete') !== 'complete') return j;%0A  for (let j = 0; j <= (afterRow ?? -1); j++) if ((state.status[j] || 'incomplete') !== 'complete') return j; // wrap%0A  return -1;%0A}%0A%0Afunction renderCards() {%0A  const q = state.search.trim().toLowerCase();%0A  const total = cardCount();%0A  const cols = cardColumns();               // display-ordered, hidden-removed%0A  const collapsed = cols.slice(0, COLLAPSED_COLS);%0A  const extra = cols.slice(COLLAPSED_COLS); // shown only when expanded%0A  let visible = 0;%0A  log(`renderCards: total=${total}, cols=${cols.length}, sort=${state.sortCol === null ? 'file' : state.sortCol + (state.sortAsc ? ' asc' : ' desc')}, search="${q}", showCompleted=${!state.hideCompleted}`);%0A  const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();%0A%0A  const copyBtn = (value, label, key) =>%0A    `<button class="icon copy" data-copy-col="${key}" data-copy-label="${esc(label)}" title="Copy ${esc(label)}">⧉</button>`;%0A%0A  const colRow = (c, i) => {%0A    const row = state.data[i + (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || [];%0A    const raw = String(row[c] ?? '').trim();%0A    if (!raw) return ''; // no value → no row, no clutter%0A    return `<div class="col-row">%0A      <span class="ck">${esc(colLabel(c))}</span>%0A      <span class="cv">${esc(raw)}</span>%0A      ${copyBtn(raw, colLabel(c), `${i}:${c}`)}%0A    </div>`;%0A  };%0A%0A  for (const i of sortedIndices()) {%0A    const row = state.data[i + (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || [];%0A    const url = String(row[state.urlCol] || '').trim();%0A    const name = String(state.nameCol >= 0 ? row[state.nameCol] : '') || url;%0A    const status = state.status[i] || 'incomplete';%0A    const notes = state.notes[i] || '';%0A%0A    if (state.hideCompleted && status === 'complete') continue;%0A    if (q && !(`${name} ${url} ${notes} ${row.join(' ')}`.toLowerCase().includes(q))) continue;%0A    visible++;%0A%0A    const expanded = !!state.expanded[i] || extra.length === 0;%0A    const shown = expanded ? cols : collapsed;%0A    const colRows = shown.map(c => colRow(c, i)).join('');%0A    const moreBtn = extra.length%0A      ? `<button class="col-more" data-toggle-col="${i}">${expanded ? '▲ Less' : `▼ +${extra.length} more column${extra.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}`}</button>`%0A      : '';%0A%0A    const card = document.createElement('article');%0A    card.className = 'card' + (status === 'complete' ? ' done' : '') + (expanded ? ' ex' : '');%0A    card.dataset.rowIndex = i; // PRD: DOM↔array mapping via data-row-index%0A    card.innerHTML = `%0A      <div class="card-top">%0A        <button class="card-title" title="Open this link (your chosen mode) + show all columns">${highlight(name, state.search.trim())}</button>%0A        ${copyBtn(name, 'name', `${i}:name`)}%0A        <a class="icon" href="${esc(url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Open in new browser tab (always a real tab)">↗</a>%0A      </div>%0A      <div class="card-url">%0A        <a href="${esc(url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="${esc(url)}">${highlight(url, state.search.trim())}</a>%0A        ${copyBtn(url, 'URL', `${i}:url`)}%0A      </div>%0A      ${colRows}%0A      ${moreBtn}%0A      <div class="card-mid">%0A        ${status === 'complete'%0A          ? `<button class="btn-undo" data-undo="${i}" title="Mark back to incomplete">↺ Incomplete</button>`%0A          : `<button class="btn-done" data-done="${i}" title="Mark complete (auto-opens next when enabled)">✓ Complete</button>`}%0A      </div>%0A      <div class="card-notes">%0A        <span class="label">Notes ${copyBtn(notes, 'notes', `${i}:notes`)}</span>%0A        <textarea rows="2" placeholder="Add a note…" data-notes="${i}">${esc(notes)}</textarea>%0A      </div>`;%0A    frag.appendChild(card);%0A  }%0A%0A  const done = state.status.filter(s => s === 'complete').length;%0A  const allDone = total > 0 && state.hideCompleted && done === total;%0A  els.cards.innerHTML = '';%0A  if (!visible) els.cards.innerHTML = `<div class="empty">${%0A    !total ? 'No file loaded yet.<br>Open a link list to populate task cards.'%0A    : allDone ? `All ${total} task${total === 1 ? '' : 's'} complete — tick “Show completed” to review them.`%0A    : 'No tasks match your filters.'}</div>`;%0A  else els.cards.appendChild(frag);%0A%0A  els.countTotal.textContent = `${total} task${total === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;%0A  els.countDone.textContent = `${done} done`;%0A  els.countLeft.textContent = `${total - done} left`;%0A  els.filterInfo.textContent = q || state.hideCompleted ? `${visible} shown · ${done} hidden` : '';%0A  log(`renderCards done: ${visible} visible, ${done} complete`);%0A}%0A%0A/** Completion side-effects: hide the done card (default) and auto-advance. */%0Afunction afterComplete(i) {%0A  if (state.autoAdvance) {%0A    const next = nextIncompleteRow(i);%0A    if (next >= 0) {%0A      log(`Auto-advance: next incomplete row is ${next}`);%0A      state.expanded[next] = true;%0A      openUrlFor(next);%0A    } else {%0A      log('Auto-advance: no incomplete rows left — queue finished!');%0A      toast('🎉 Queue finished — every task is complete', 'success');%0A    }%0A  }%0A  renderCards();%0A  markDirty();%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------------ Open modes -------------------------------- */%0A/* How a card's link opens: tabbed iframes, a real browser tab, or a popup window.%0A   User-selectable at any time; remembered across sessions. */%0Aconst LS_OPEN_MODE = 'turnstone-open-mode';%0Aconst OPEN_MODES = {%0A  tabs:   { label: 'Tabs (iframes)',       hint: 'Open inside this app, one tab per link' },%0A  newtab: { label: 'New browser tab',      hint: 'Hand off to a full browser tab' },%0A  newwin: { label: 'New popup window',     hint: 'Small always-on-top window beside the queue' },%0A};%0A%0Afunction getOpenMode() {%0A  try { const m = localStorage.getItem(LS_OPEN_MODE); if (OPEN_MODES[m]) return m; } catch (e) {}%0A  return 'tabs';%0A}%0A%0Afunction setOpenMode(m, announce = true) {%0A  if (!OPEN_MODES[m]) return;%0A  try { localStorage.setItem(LS_OPEN_MODE, m); } catch (e) { warn('Could not persist open mode', e); }%0A  if (announce) { log(`Open mode → ${OPEN_MODES[m].label}`); toast(`Links now open as ${OPEN_MODES[m].label.toLowerCase()}`); }%0A  renderModeMenu();%0A}%0A%0A/** Open a task URL according to the current mode. */%0Afunction openUrlFor(i) {%0A  const url = String((state.data[i + (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || [])[state.urlCol] || '').trim();%0A  if (!url) { warn(`openUrlFor(${i}): no URL in row`); return; }%0A  const mode = getOpenMode();%0A  log(`Opening row ${i} as ${mode}: ${url}`);%0A  if (mode === 'tabs') { openInIframe(url, i); return; }%0A  if (mode === 'newtab') { window.open(url, '_blank', 'noopener'); return; }%0A  if (mode === 'newwin') {%0A    const w = window.open(url, 'turnstone-win', 'popup=yes,width=1024,height=768,noopener');%0A    if (!w) toast('Popup blocked — allow popups for this site, or use Tabs/New tab mode', 'error');%0A  }%0A}%0A%0Afunction renderModeMenu() {%0A  const mode = getOpenMode();%0A  els.menu.querySelectorAll('.mode-item').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('checked', b.dataset.mode === mode));%0A  els.tabbar.classList.toggle('hidden-mode', mode !== 'tabs');%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------- Tabbed iframe workspace ------------------------ */%0Alet tabs = [];        // { id, url, title, rowId }%0Alet activeTabId = null;%0Alet tabSeq = 0;%0A%0A/** PRD Task 3.2: open (or focus) a URL in a tabbed iframe. */%0Afunction openInIframe(url, rowId) {%0A  if (!url) { warn('openInIframe called with empty URL'); return; }%0A  const existing = tabs.find(t => t.rowId === rowId && t.url === url);%0A  if (existing) { log(`Tab for row ${rowId} already open → focusing tab ${existing.id}`); activateTab(existing.id); return; }%0A%0A  const id = 'tab-' + (++tabSeq);%0A  const title = tabTitle(url, rowId);%0A  log(`Opening iframe tab ${id}: "${title}" → ${url}`);%0A  tabs.push({ id, url, title, rowId });%0A%0A  const pane = document.createElement('div');%0A  pane.className = 'pane'; pane.id = id; pane.dataset.tabId = id;%0A  pane.innerHTML = `<iframe src="${esc(url)}" referrerpolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade" allow="fullscreen"></iframe>`;%0A  els.panes.appendChild(pane);%0A%0A  renderTabbar();%0A  activateTab(id);%0A}%0A%0Afunction tabTitle(url, rowId) {%0A  const row = state.data[rowId + (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || [];%0A  const name = String(state.nameCol >= 0 ? row[state.nameCol] : '').trim();%0A  let t = name || url.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '');%0A  if (t.length > 26) t = t.slice(0, 25) + '…';%0A  return t;%0A}%0A%0Afunction renderTabbar() {%0A  els.tabbar.innerHTML = '';%0A  for (const t of tabs) {%0A    const tab = document.createElement('div');%0A    tab.className = 'tab' + (t.id === activeTabId ? ' active' : '');%0A    tab.dataset.tabId = t.id;%0A    tab.title = t.url;%0A    tab.innerHTML = `%0A      <span class="tab-title">${esc(t.title)}</span>%0A      <a class="tab-ext" href="${esc(t.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="Open in new browser tab">↗</a>%0A      <button class="tab-close" title="Close tab">✕</button>`;%0A    els.tabbar.appendChild(tab);%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/** PRD Task 3.3: switch tabs by hiding/showing panes (iframes never reload). */%0Afunction activateTab(id) {%0A  activeTabId = id;%0A  const target = tabs.find(t => t.id === id);%0A  log(`Activating tab ${id}${target ? ` (${target.title})` : ''}`);%0A  for (const pane of els.panes.querySelectorAll('.pane')) pane.classList.toggle('active', pane.id === id);%0A  renderTabbar();%0A}%0A%0Afunction closeTab(id) {%0A  const idx = tabs.findIndex(t => t.id === id);%0A  if (idx < 0) return;%0A  log(`Closing tab ${id} (${tabs[idx].title})`);%0A  els.panes.querySelector(`%23${CSS.escape(id)}`)?.remove(); // destroys the iframe%0A  tabs.splice(idx, 1);%0A  if (activeTabId === id) {%0A    const next = tabs[Math.min(idx, tabs.length - 1)];%0A    activeTabId = next ? next.id : null;%0A  }%0A  renderTabbar();%0A  if (activeTabId) activateTab(activeTabId);%0A}%0A%0Afunction closeAllTabs() {%0A  if (tabs.length) log(`Closing all ${tabs.length} tab(s) for new file`);%0A  tabs = []; activeTabId = null;%0A  els.tabbar.innerHTML = '';%0A  els.panes.querySelectorAll('.pane').forEach(p => p.remove());%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------ Write-back & persistence ----------------------- */%0Alet saveTimer = null;%0A%0A/** PRD Task 4.1: debounced auto-save (1.2s in FS mode, 0.7s fallback). */%0Afunction markDirty() {%0A  state.isDirty = true;%0A  updateSaveIndicator();%0A  scheduleSave();%0A}%0Afunction scheduleSave(delay) {%0A  clearTimeout(saveTimer);%0A  const d = delay ?? (state.mode === 'fs' ? 1200 : 700);%0A  saveTimer = setTimeout(saveNow, d);%0A}%0A%0Aasync function saveNow() {%0A  if (!state.mode || !cardCount()) return;%0A  clearTimeout(saveTimer);%0A  const t0 = performance.now();%0A  log(`saveNow: mode=${state.mode}, dirty=${state.isDirty}`);%0A  try {%0A    if (state.mode === 'fs' && state.fileHandle && canWrite(state.ext)) {%0A      const perm = await state.fileHandle.queryPermission({ mode: 'readwrite' });%0A      if (perm !== 'granted') {%0A        warn('Write permission lost — cannot silently save. Data kept in memory.');%0A        toast('File permission expired — use Restore Workspace to re-authorize, then edit again.', 'error');%0A        await persistSessionSnapshot(); // safety net%0A        return;%0A      }%0A      await writeBackToFile();%0A      state.isDirty = false;%0A      state.lastSavedAt = Date.now(); state.lastSavedWhere = 'to file';%0A      log(`Wrote file "${state.name}" in ${(performance.now() - t0).toFixed(0)}ms`);%0A    } else {%0A      await persistSessionSnapshot();%0A      state.isDirty = state.mode !== 'fs'; // fallback stays dirty until exported%0A      state.lastSavedAt = Date.now(); state.lastSavedWhere = 'to browser storage';%0A      log(`Saved session snapshot in ${(performance.now() - t0).toFixed(0)}ms`);%0A    }%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    err('Save failed', e);%0A    toast(`Save failed: ${e.message}`, 'error');%0A  }%0A  updateSaveIndicator();%0A}%0A%0A/** Merge virtual Status/Notes columns into an export matrix. */%0Afunction buildExportMatrix() {%0A  let next = state.data.reduce((m, r) => Math.max(m, r.length), 1);%0A  const stCol = state.statusCol >= 0 ? state.statusCol : next++;%0A  const ntCol = state.notesCol >= 0 ? state.notesCol : next++;%0A%0A  const out = [];%0A  if (state.hasHeader) {%0A    const header = state.data[0].slice();%0A    while (header.length < next) header.push('');%0A    header[stCol] = 'Status';%0A    header[ntCol] = 'Notes';%0A    out.push(header);%0A  } else {%0A    out.push(Array.from({ length: next }, (_, c) => c === state.urlCol ? 'URL' : c === stCol ? 'Status' : c === ntCol ? 'Notes' : `Column ${c + 1}`));%0A    log('No header row in source — a header row will be added on write-back to persist Status/Notes');%0A  }%0A  for (let i = 0; i < cardCount(); i++) {%0A    const row = (state.data[i + (state.hasHeader ? 1 : 0)] || []).slice();%0A    while (row.length < next) row.push('');%0A    row[stCol] = state.status[i] || 'incomplete';%0A    row[ntCol] = state.notes[i] || '';%0A    out.push(row);%0A  }%0A  log(`buildExportMatrix: ${out.length} rows × ${next} cols (status@${stCol}, notes@${ntCol})`);%0A  return out;%0A}%0A%0A/** PRD Task 4.1: silent write-back via File System Access API. */%0Aasync function writeBackToFile() {%0A  const matrix = buildExportMatrix();%0A  const writable = await state.fileHandle.createWritable();%0A  try {%0A    if (isWorkbookFormat(state.ext)) {%0A      const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();%0A      XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(matrix), sanitizeSheetName(state.sheetName));%0A      await writable.write(XLSX.write(wb, { type: 'array', bookType: 'xlsx' }));%0A    } else {%0A      // Delimited text keeps its own delimiter so a TSV source stays a TSV.%0A      await writable.write(Papa.unparse(matrix, { delimiter: state.ext === 'tsv' ? '\t' : ',' }));%0A    }%0A  } finally {%0A    await writable.close();%0A  }%0A  log(`Write-back complete (${state.ext})`);%0A}%0A%0Afunction sanitizeSheetName(n) {%0A  const clean = String(n || 'Sheet1').replace(/[\\/?*[\]:]/g, '_');%0A  return clean.slice(0, 31) || 'Sheet1';%0A}%0A%0A/** PRD Task 4.3: fallback persistence — full snapshot to IndexedDB. */%0Aasync function persistSessionSnapshot() {%0A  try {%0A    await idbPut('session', {%0A      key: 'session', name: state.name, ext: state.ext, sheetName: state.sheetName,%0A      data: state.data, status: state.status, notes: state.notes, sourceUrl: state.sourceUrl, ts: Date.now(),%0A    });%0A    log(`Session snapshot persisted (${cardCount()} cards)`);%0A  } catch (e) {%0A    err('Session snapshot failed (file too large for IndexedDB?)', e);%0A  }%0A}%0A%0A/* PRD Task 4.3: export via Blob download (always available). */%0Afunction exportFile(kind) {%0A  if (kind === 'xlsx' && !HAS_XLSX_WRITE) {%0A    warn('XLSX export requested in a build without a workbook writer');%0A    toast('XLSX export is not in this build — Export CSV instead', 'error');%0A    return;%0A  }%0A  const matrix = buildExportMatrix();%0A  const base = (state.name || 'turnstone').replace(/\.[a-z0-9]+$/i, '');%0A  const a = document.createElement('a');%0A  if (kind === 'xlsx') {%0A    const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();%0A    XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet(matrix), sanitizeSheetName(state.sheetName));%0A    const buf = XLSX.write(wb, { type: 'array', bookType: 'xlsx' });%0A    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([buf], { type: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' }));%0A    a.download = base + '.xlsx';%0A  } else {%0A    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([Papa.unparse(matrix)], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8' }));%0A    a.download = base + '-turnstone.csv';%0A  }%0A  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();%0A  log(`Exported ${a.download} (${kind})`);%0A  toast(`Exported ${a.download}`, 'success');%0A}%0A%0A/* beforeunload guard removed in the bookmarklet build: leaving a page is the host%0A   page's business, and our state is session-only by design anyway. */%0A// Safety net: flush pending debounced saves when the tab is hidden.%0Adocument.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {%0A  if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden' && state.isDirty) { log('Visibility hidden → flushing pending save'); saveNow(); }%0A});%0A%0A/* PWA plumbing removed in the bookmarklet build — an installed app and an%0A   install prompt belong to a real origin, not to a page we were launched from. */%0A%0A/* Service worker: offline shell. Skipped on plain file:// (nothing to serve), and%0A   skipped in the standalone single-file build, where there is no sw.js to load.%0A   assets/build-standalone.js flips STANDALONE_BUILD to true. */%0Aconst STANDALONE_BUILD = true;%0Aif (!STANDALONE_BUILD && (location.protocol === 'https:' || location.hostname === 'localhost' || location.hostname === '127.0.0.1')) {%0A  if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {%0A    navigator.serviceWorker.register('sw.js')%0A      .then((reg) => log(`Service worker registered (scope: ${reg.scope})`))%0A      .catch((e) => warn('Service worker registration failed (offline mode unavailable)', e));%0A  }%0A} else {%0A  log(STANDALONE_BUILD ? 'Service worker skipped (standalone single-file build)' : `Service worker skipped on ${location.protocol} origin`);%0A}%0A%0A/* Install button: only shown when the browser fires beforeinstallprompt. */%0Alet deferredInstallPrompt = null;%0Awindow.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', (e) => {%0A  e.preventDefault();%0A  deferredInstallPrompt = e;%0A  els.miInstall.hidden = false;%0A  log('Turnstone is installable → Install item shown in menu');%0A});%0Aels.miInstall.addEventListener('click', async () => {%0A  closeMenu();%0A  if (!deferredInstallPrompt) return;%0A  deferredInstallPrompt.prompt();%0A  const { outcome } = await deferredInstallPrompt.userChoice;%0A  log(`Install prompt outcome: ${outcome}`);%0A  deferredInstallPrompt = null;%0A  els.miInstall.hidden = true;%0A});%0Awindow.addEventListener('appinstalled', () => {%0A  els.miInstall.hidden = true;%0A  log('Turnstone installed as an app');%0A  toast('Turnstone installed — find it in your apps menu', 'success');%0A});%0A%0A/* ----------------------------- Demo dataset ------------------------------ */%0Aconst DEMO_CSV = `Name,URL,Notes%0AExample Domain,https://example.com/,%0AHTTPBin HTML,https://httpbin.org/html/,%0AMDN Web Docs,https://developer.mozilla.org/,%0AOpenStreetMap Embed,https://www.openstreetmap.org/export/embed.html?bbox=-0.2%252C51.4%252C0.0%252C51.6&layer=mapnik,%0AWikipedia,https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Main_Page,`;%0A%0Afunction loadDemo() {%0A  log('Loading demo dataset');%0A  const matrix = parseDelimitedText(DEMO_CSV, 'csv');%0A  loadMatrix(matrix, { name: 'demo-links.csv', ext: 'csv', mode: 'demo', sourceUrl: null });%0A  scheduleSave(0);%0A}%0A%0A/* ------------------------------ Event wiring ----------------------------- */%0A/* Hamburger menu */%0Afunction openMenu() {%0A  els.menu.hidden = false;%0A  const r = els.btnMenu.getBoundingClientRect();%0A  els.menu.style.left = Math.min(r.left, window.innerWidth - 276) + 'px';%0A  log('Menu opened');%0A}%0Afunction closeMenu() { els.menu.hidden = true; }%0Aels.btnMenu.addEventListener('click', (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); els.menu.hidden ? openMenu() : closeMenu(); });%0Adocument.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if (!els.menu.hidden && !e.target.closest('%23menu') && !e.target.closest('%23btn-menu')) closeMenu(); });%0Adocument.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeMenu(); });%0Awindow.addEventListener('resize', () => { if (!els.menu.hidden) closeMenu(); });%0A%0Aels.miOpen.addEventListener('click', () => { closeMenu(); openLocalFile(); });%0A%0A/* Drop zone: click/press to pick a file. Drops themselves are handled on the%0A   document (below) so that a file dropped anywhere still loads — and, just as%0A   importantly, so the browser never navigates away to the dropped file. */%0Aels.dropzone.addEventListener('click', openLocalFile);%0Aels.dropzone.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {%0A  if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault();   // left the window%0A});%0AROOT.addEventListener('drop', async (e) => {%0A  els.dropzone.classList.remove('over');%0A  if (!isFileDrag(e)) return;                 // an in-page drag: not ours to handle%0A  e.preventDefault();%0A  try {%0A    await handleDroppedFiles(e.dataTransfer);%0A  } catch (err2) {%0A    err('Dropped-file load failed', err2);%0A    toast(`Could not read the dropped file: ${err2.message}`, 'error');%0A  }%0A});%0Awindow.addEventListener('blur', () => els.dropzone.classList.remove('over'));%0Aels.miRestore.addEventListener('click', () => { closeMenu(); } catch (e) { return false; } }%0Afunction getAutoAdvance() { try { return localStorage.getItem(LS_AUTO_ADV) === '1'; } catch (e) { return false; } }%0Afunction renderAutoMenu() {%0A  els.miAutoOpen.classList.toggle('checked', getAutoOpen());%0A  els.miAutoAdvance.classList.toggle('checked', getAutoAdvance());%0A}%0Aels.miAutoOpen.addEventListener('click', () => {%0A  const next = !getAutoOpen();%0A  try { localStorage.setItem(LS_AUTO_OPEN, next ? '1' : '0'); } catch (e) {}%0A  state.autoOpenOnSelect = next;%0A  log(`Auto-open-on-select → ${next}`);%0A  toast(next ? 'Cards auto-open their link when selected' : 'Auto-open on select is off');%0A  renderAutoMenu();%0A});%0Aels.miAutoAdvance.addEventListener('click', () => {%0A  const next = !getAutoAdvance();%0A  try { localStorage.setItem(LS_AUTO_ADV, next ? This is also where the locked-scope "carry a queue across%0A * sessions" pair lives: storage is session-only by design (see boot-pre), so%0A * Copy state / Restore state is the supported way to move a queue between tabs.%0A * ------------------------------------------------------------------------- */%0A%0A(function tsWireBar() {%0A  var bar = TS_SHADOW.getElementById('ts-bar');%0A  var label = TS_BMK.variant + (TS_BMK.libs.length ?
